365void CAlphaCPU::release_threads()
366{
367 try {
368 mySemaphore.set();
369 }
370 catch (const std::overflow_error&) {
371 // Already signaled, nothing to do

375void CAlphaCPU::run()
376{
377 try
378 {
379 mySemaphore.wait();
380 while (state.wait_for_start)
381 {
382 if (StopThread)
383 return;
384 CThread::sleep(1);
385 }
386 printf("*** CPU%d *** STARTING ***\n", get_cpuid());
387#if defined(ES40_JIT_X64)
388 // Code can survive LoadROM and an earlier worker thread.
389 if (m_jit) CJitEngine::serialize_code();
390#endif
391#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
392 if (m_jit && get_cpuid() == 0 && getenv("ES40_JIT_SAMPLER")) jit_sampler_start();
393#endif
394
395#if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__x86_64__)
396 // Pin host SSE state for the JIT FP path: round-nearest, exceptions masked,
397 // FTZ/DAZ off (denormal results must materialize to hit the interp-bail).
398 _mm_setcsr(0x1F80);
399#elif defined(_M_ARM64)
400 // Same pin for the A64 JIT FP path: FPCR = 0 is RN, FZ/FZ16 off, DN off, traps masked.
401 _WriteStatusReg(ARM64_FPCR, 0);
402#elif defined(__aarch64__)
403 // Same pin for the A64 JIT FP path: FPCR = 0 is RN, FZ/FZ16 off, DN off, traps masked.
404 { const unsigned long long fpcr_default = 0; __asm__ __volatile__("msr fpcr, %0" :: "r"(fpcr_default)); }
405#endif
406
407 // Re-base the timing-calibration epoch to when execution actually begins:
408 // a secondary parks (wait_for_start) before the primary releases it, so
409 // leaving start_time at init time makes check_state() derive a wildly
410 // wrong cc_per_instruction (huge elapsed wall-time vs ~0 instructions).
411 start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
412 next_timer_fire = start_time;
413 tick_last_fire = start_time;
414 cc_last_sync = start_time;
415 cc_large = 0;
416 state.instruction_count = 0;
417 reset_idle_detector();
418 prev_icount = 0;
419 prev_cc = 0;
420 prev_time = 0;
421
422 for (;;)
423 {
424 if (StopThread)
425 return;
426#ifdef ES40_JIT
427 // One chain ceiling per batch of clock and timer work.
428 jit_run((int) CJitEngine::kChainCeiling);
429#else
430 // execute() now owns a 512-instruction batch. Calling it 2,000 times
431 // here accidentally turned one scheduler turn into ~1M instructions,
432 // starving peer CPUs and device workers during native-PAL SMP handoffs.
433 execute();
434 CThread::yield();
435#endif
436 if (cSystem && cSystem->IsSystemResetRequested())
437 {
438 CThread::sleep(1);
439 continue;
440 }
441 }
442 }
443 catch (CException& e)
444 {
445 printf("Exception in CPU thread: %s.\n", e.displayText().c_str());
446
447 // Let the thread die...
448 }
449}

451// Discard evidence from the previous execution history without changing guest state.
452void CAlphaCPU::reset_idle_detector()
453{
454 idle_spin_min_instr = 0; // Relearn from the next dispatch's instruction budget.
455 m_spin_ic = state.instruction_count;
456 m_spin_hits = 0;
457 for (auto& pc : m_spin_set)
458 pc = 0;
459 for (auto& v : m_spin_loop)
460 v = IDLE_LOOP_UNKNOWN;
461 m_spin_set_n = 0;
462 if (m_idle_armed && cSystem)
463 cSystem->idle_watch_disarm(state.iProcNum);
464 m_idle_armed = false;
465 m_spin_engaged_n = 0;
466 m_spin_rejected_n = 0;
467 m_spin_traced_n = 0;
468 m_ipl0_ier_known = false;
469}

471// Read the idle_detect settings; shared by init and system reset.
472void CAlphaCPU::load_idle_config()
473{
474 const char* _m = myCfg->get_text_value("idle_detect", "off");
475 idle_rule = idle_method_by_name(_m);
476 if (idle_rule < 0)
477 {
478 printf("*** CPU%d *** unknown idle_detect \"%s\" -- idle detection OFF. Known:", get_cpuid(), _m);
479 for (int _i = 0; idle_methods[_i].name; _i++)
480 printf(" %s", idle_methods[_i].name);
481 printf("\n");
482 idle_rule = RULE_NONE;
483 }
484 idle_spin_count = (u32) myCfg->get_num_value("idle_spin_count", false, 2);
485 idle_nap_poll_us = (u32) myCfg->get_num_value("idle_nap_poll_us", false, 100);
486 idle_mp_nap_us = (u32) myCfg->get_num_value("idle_mp_nap_us", false, 0);
487 idle_mp_wake = myCfg->get_bool_value("idle_mp_wake", false);
488 idle_detect_debug = myCfg->get_bool_value("idle_detect_debug", false);
489 if (idle_nap_poll_us < 1)
490 idle_nap_poll_us = 1;
491 if (idle_spin_count < 1)
492 idle_spin_count = 1;
493
494 // Guest virtual addresses, so hex: get_num_value only takes decimal.
495 idle_pc_lo = strtoull(myCfg->get_text_value("idle_pc_lo", "0"), nullptr, 0);
496 idle_pc_hi = strtoull(myCfg->get_text_value("idle_pc_hi", "0"), nullptr, 0);
497 if (idle_pc_hi && idle_pc_hi <= idle_pc_lo)
498 {
499 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle_pc_hi must be above idle_pc_lo; idle PC window ignored\n", get_cpuid());
500 idle_pc_lo = idle_pc_hi = 0;
501 }
502}

516void CAlphaCPU::idle_nap(bool detected)
517{
518 using namespace std::chrono;
519
520 // Either route may nap: WTINT, or host-side detection.
521 if (!idle_nap_enabled && idle_rule == RULE_NONE)
522 return;
523 const bool mp = cSystem && cSystem->get_cpu_num() > 1;
524 const bool watched = mp && detected && m_idle_armed;
525 if (mp && !(detected && idle_rule == RULE_SPIN_KERNEL && (watched || idle_mp_nap_us)))
526 return;
527
528 if (!idle_announced)
529 {
530 idle_announced = true;
531 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle nap engaged ***\n", get_cpuid());
532 fflush(stdout); // stdout is block-buffered when captured by a service manager
533 }
534 m_idle_stat.naps++;
535
536 const auto start = steady_clock::now();
537 auto deadline = start + (mp && !watched ? microseconds(idle_mp_nap_us) : microseconds(1000));
538 if (state.iProcNum == 0)
539 {
540 // A due tick still waits for the catch-up gap (service_interval_timer).
541 auto fire = next_timer_fire;
542 if (tick_last_fire + nanoseconds(tick_gap_ns) > fire)
543 fire = tick_last_fire + nanoseconds(tick_gap_ns);
544 if (fire < deadline)
545 deadline = fire;
546 }
547 if (deadline <= start)
548 m_idle_stat.late++;
549
550 // Asleep, this CPU stores nothing: don't hold up another CPU's first LDx_L watch.
551 {
552 CSystem::JitExecutionPause pause(cSystem, state.iProcNum);
553 for (;;)
554 {
555 // Register interest before checking work.
556 const auto generation = m_idle_wake.generation();
557 if (state.check_int || state.check_timers || StopThread
558 || (cSystem && cSystem->IsSystemResetRequested()))
559 {
560 m_idle_stat.cut_int++;
561 break;
562 }
563 if (watched && cSystem->idle_watch_fired(state.iProcNum))
564 {
565 m_idle_stat.woke++;
566 break;
567 }
568 if (steady_clock::now() >= deadline)
569 break;
570 if (m_idle_wake.wait_until(generation, deadline, microseconds(idle_nap_poll_us)))
571 break;
572 }
573 }
574 // Rearm from a fresh pass: the guest must see whatever ended the nap.
575 if (watched)
576 {
577 cSystem->idle_watch_disarm(state.iProcNum);
578 m_idle_armed = false;
579 }
580 if (idle_detect_debug)
581 m_idle_stat.slept_ns += (u64) duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now() - start).count();
582 // The wait releases its host locks before entering the system interrupt path.
583 if (!StopThread && !(cSystem && cSystem->IsSystemResetRequested()))
584 service_interval_timer(steady_clock::now());
585}

587// Guest RAM behind a data read, for idle_loop_trace. Uses only existing
588// translations: no TB fill, fault or device access.
589bool CAlphaCPU::idle_load_ram(u64 va, int bytes, u64* value, u64* phys)
590{
591 u64 pa;
592 bool asm_bit;
593 if (virt2phys(va, &pa, ACCESS_READ | NO_CHECK | FAKE, &asm_bit, 0))
594 return false;
595 if (pa + (u64) bytes > (U64(1) << cSystem->get_memory_bits()))
596 return false;
597 *value = cSystem->ReadMem(pa, bytes * 8, this);
598 *phys = pa;
599 return true;
600}

602// One idle_detect sample at a JIT dispatch, before the code at start_virt runs.
603void CAlphaCPU::idle_detect_sample(u64 start_virt, const AlphaInstructionSource& sources)
604{
605 const u64 _ic = state.instruction_count;
606 const int _ipl = (int) ((state.r[32 + 22] >> 8) & 0x1f); // VMS PALcode keeps PS in p22
607
608 const bool _kernel = state.cm == 0 && !(start_virt & 1); // IER_CM kernel, not PALmode
609 const bool _in_window = !idle_pc_hi
610 || (start_virt >= idle_pc_lo && start_virt < idle_pc_hi);
611
612 // OSF user mode always runs at IPL 0, so its IER enables are the reference.
613 if (idle_rule == RULE_SPIN_KERNEL && state.cm != 0 && !(start_virt & 1))
614 {
615 m_ipl0_eien = state.eien;
616 m_ipl0_sien = state.sien;
617 m_ipl0_ier_known = true;
618 }
619 if (idle_detect_debug)
620 {
621 const bool _sample = (_ic - m_spin_ic) >= idle_spin_min_instr;
622 m_idle_stat.samples += _sample;
623 m_idle_stat.kernel += _sample && _kernel;
624 const auto _now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
625 if (_now >= m_idle_stat_next)
626 {
627 if (m_idle_stat_next.time_since_epoch().count())
628 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle stats 10s: samples=%llu kernel=%llu decided=%llu naps=%llu slept=%llums int_cut=%llu woke=%llu late=%llu last_reject=%s ***\n",
629 get_cpuid(), (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.samples, (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.kernel,
630 (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.decided, (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.naps,
631 (unsigned long long) (m_idle_stat.slept_ns / 1000000), (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.cut_int,
632 (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.woke,
633 (unsigned long long) m_idle_stat.late, m_idle_stat.why ? m_idle_stat.why : "-");
634 m_idle_stat = {};
635 m_idle_stat_next = _now + std::chrono::seconds(10);
636 }
637 }
638
639 if ((_ic - m_spin_ic) >= idle_spin_min_instr
640 && (idle_rule != RULE_SPIN_IPL3 || _ipl == 3)
641 && (idle_rule != RULE_SPIN_KERNEL || _kernel)
642 && _in_window)
643 {
644 int _slot = -1;
645 for (int _i = 0; _i < m_spin_set_n; _i++)
646 if (m_spin_set[_i] == start_virt)
647 {
648 _slot = _i;
649 break;
650 }
651 if (_slot < 0)
652 {
653 // A new address breaks the run of consecutive repeated PCs.
654 m_spin_hits = 0;
655 if (m_spin_set_n < kSpinSetMax)
656 {
657 m_spin_loop[m_spin_set_n] = IDLE_LOOP_UNKNOWN;
658 m_spin_set[m_spin_set_n++] = start_virt;
659 }
660 else
661 {
662 m_spin_set_n = 0; // too wide to be a loop: start over
663 }
664 }
665 else if (++m_spin_hits >= idle_spin_count)
666 {
667 m_spin_hits = idle_spin_count; // saturate
668
669 auto _read = [&](u64 va, u32* insn) {
670 const auto view = sources.view(va);
671 if (!view.contains(1))
672 return false;
673 *insn = view.word(0);
674 return true;
675 };
676 const char* _why = nullptr;
677 if (idle_rule == RULE_SPIN_KERNEL)
678 {
679 if (!m_ipl0_ier_known)
680 _why = "no user-mode IPL 0 reference yet";
681 else if (state.eien != m_ipl0_eien || state.sien != m_ipl0_sien)
682 _why = "interrupt enables differ from IPL 0";
683 else
684 {
685 u8& _loop = m_spin_loop[_slot];
686 if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_UNKNOWN)
687 _loop = (u8) idle_loop_check(start_virt, _read);
688 if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_STORES)
689 _why = "loop writes memory or leaves";
690 else if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_WALKS)
691 _why = "loop reads through an advancing address";
692 else if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_CALLS)
693 _why = "loop calls a function on every pass";
694 else if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_COMPUTES)
695 _why = "loop branches only on computed values";
696 else if (_loop == IDLE_LOOP_UNREADABLE)
697 _why = "no short loop at this pc";
698 }
699 }
700
701 // Firmware and early boot spins are expected; don't log them.
702 m_idle_stat.decided++;
703 if (_why)
704 m_idle_stat.why = _why;
705 if (_why && m_idle_armed)
706 {
707 cSystem->idle_watch_disarm(state.iProcNum);
708 m_idle_armed = false;
709 }
710 if (_why && m_ipl0_ier_known && idle_detect_debug)
711 {
712 bool _shown = false;
713 for (int _i = 0; _i < m_spin_rejected_n; _i++)
714 _shown |= m_spin_rejected[_i] == start_virt;
715 if (!_shown && m_spin_rejected_n < 64)
716 {
717 m_spin_rejected[m_spin_rejected_n++] = start_virt;
718 u64 _at = 0;
719 u32 _insn = 0;
720 const int _loop = m_spin_loop[_slot];
721 if (_loop != IDLE_LOOP_UNKNOWN && _loop != IDLE_LOOP_UNREADABLE)
722 idle_loop_check(start_virt, _read, &_at); // again, for the deciding instruction
723 if (_at)
724 _read(_at, &_insn);
725 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle_detect rejected pc=%016llx: %s",
726 get_cpuid(), (unsigned long long) start_virt, _why);
727 if (_at)
728 printf(" at %016llx insn=%08x", (unsigned long long) _at, _insn);
729 printf(" (eien=%02x sien=%04x, IPL 0 eien=%02x sien=%04x) ***\n",
730 state.eien, state.sien, m_ipl0_eien, m_ipl0_sien);
731 fflush(stdout);
732 }
733 }
734 else if (!_why)
735 {
736 // SMP idle watch: arm on this sample and nap on the next, so the
737 // guest makes one pass that sees every store before the arm.
738 bool _nap = true;
739 if (idle_mp_wake && idle_rule == RULE_SPIN_KERNEL && !m_idle_armed
740 && cSystem->get_cpu_num() > 1)
741 {
742 u64 _lines[CSystem::kIdleWatchLines], _at = 0;
743 auto _load = [&](u64 va, int bytes, u64* value, u64* phys) {
744 return idle_load_ram(va, bytes, value, phys);
745 };
746 const int _n = idle_loop_trace(start_virt, &state.r[0], _read, _load,
747 _lines, CSystem::kIdleWatchLines, &_at);
748 m_idle_armed = _n > 0 && cSystem->idle_watch_arm(state.iProcNum, _lines, _n);
749 _nap = !m_idle_armed; // untraceable: timed nap if idle_mp_nap_us, else none
750 // A trace can fail once and succeed later (work dispatched
751 // mid-pass), so report the first of each outcome per PC.
752 const u64 _key = start_virt | (m_idle_armed ? 0 : 2);
753 bool _shown = false;
754 for (int _i = 0; _i < m_spin_traced_n; _i++)
755 _shown |= m_spin_traced[_i] == _key;
756 if (idle_detect_debug && !_shown && m_spin_traced_n < 16)
757 {
758 m_spin_traced[m_spin_traced_n++] = _key;
759 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle_detect pc=%016llx ", get_cpuid(), (unsigned long long) start_virt);
760 if (m_idle_armed)
761 {
762 printf("watches %d lines:", _n);
763 for (int _i = 0; _i < _n; _i++)
764 printf(" %llx", (unsigned long long) (_lines[_i] << 6));
765 }
766 else
767 printf("cannot watch its loop (trace stopped at %016llx, %d lines)",
768 (unsigned long long) _at, _n);
769 printf(" ***\n");
770 fflush(stdout);
771 }
772 }
773 bool _shown = false;
774 for (int _i = 0; _i < m_spin_engaged_n; _i++)
775 _shown |= m_spin_engaged[_i] == start_virt;
776 if (!_shown && m_spin_engaged_n < (idle_detect_debug ? 8 : 1))
777 {
778 m_spin_engaged[m_spin_engaged_n++] = start_virt;
779 // idle_nap's gate: with more than one CPU, only opted-in "tru64" naps.
780 const char* _mp_off = nullptr;
781 if (cSystem->get_cpu_num() > 1 && idle_rule != RULE_SPIN_KERNEL)
782 _mp_off = "this idle_detect mode naps only with one CPU";
783 else if (cSystem->get_cpu_num() > 1 && !idle_mp_wake && !idle_mp_nap_us)
784 _mp_off = "more than one CPU needs idle_mp_wake";
785 if (_mp_off)
786 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle_detect found idle at pc=%016llx, not napping: %s ***\n",
787 get_cpuid(), (unsigned long long) start_virt, _mp_off);
788 else
789 printf("*** CPU%d *** idle_detect engaged at pc=%016llx ipl=%d cm=%d eien=%02x sien=%04x ***\n",
790 get_cpuid(), (unsigned long long) start_virt, _ipl, state.cm,
791 state.eien, state.sien);
792 fflush(stdout);
793 }
794 if (_nap)
795 idle_nap(true);
796 }
797 }
798 }
799 else
800 {
801 m_spin_hits = 0;
802 m_spin_set_n = 0;
803 if (m_idle_armed && (_ic - m_spin_ic) >= idle_spin_min_instr)
804 {
805 cSystem->idle_watch_disarm(state.iProcNum); // left the idle loop
806 m_idle_armed = false;
807 }
808 }
809 m_spin_ic = _ic;
810}

812// System interval-timer policy shared by both execution engines and idle paths.
813void CAlphaCPU::service_interval_timer(std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point now)
814{
815 if (state.iProcNum == 0)
816 {
817 if (now >= next_timer_fire)
818 {
819 const u64 period_ns = theAli ? theAli->get_interval_period_ns() : 0;
820 if (period_ns)
821 {
822 // Count-preserving, paced catch-up.
823 if (now - tick_last_fire >= std::chrono::nanoseconds(tick_gap_ns))
824 {
825 cSystem->interrupt(-1, true);
826 tick_last_fire = now;
827 tick_gap_ns = tick_next_gap_ns(period_ns);
828 next_timer_fire += std::chrono::nanoseconds(period_ns);
829 if (now - next_timer_fire > std::chrono::seconds(1))
830 next_timer_fire = now;
831 }
832 }
833 else
834 {
835 cSystem->interrupt(-1, true);
836 tick_last_fire = now;
837 next_timer_fire = now + std::chrono::seconds(1);
838 }
839 }
840 }
841}
842
843u64 CAlphaCPU::tick_next_gap_ns(u64 period_ns)
844{
845 tick_fire_idx++;
846 const u32 ph = tick_fire_idx % 277;
847 const u32 tri = (ph <= 138) ? ph : (277 - ph);
848 tick_pace_lcg = tick_pace_lcg * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
849 return period_ns / 2 + period_ns * tri / 400
850 + period_ns * ((tick_pace_lcg >> 24) & 0x3f) / 1024;
851}

858CAlphaCPU::TickHold CAlphaCPU::tick_hold(u64 period_ns)
859{
860 using namespace std::chrono;
861
862 const u32 seq = tick_seen_seq;
863 auto deadline = steady_clock::now() + nanoseconds(2 * period_ns); // secondaries: backstop if CPU0 is late
864 if (state.iProcNum == 0)
865 {
866 deadline = next_timer_fire;
867 if (tick_last_fire + nanoseconds(tick_gap_ns) > deadline)
868 deadline = tick_last_fire + nanoseconds(tick_gap_ns);
869 }
870
871 for (;;)
872 {
873 if (cSystem->get_tick_seq() != seq)
874 return TickHold::Ticked;
875 if (state.check_int || StopThread || cSystem->IsSystemResetRequested())
876 return TickHold::Doorbell;
877 const auto now = steady_clock::now();
878 if (now >= deadline)
879 return state.iProcNum == 0 ? TickHold::Ticked : TickHold::Expired;
880 auto nap = deadline - now;
881 if (nap > microseconds(100))
882 nap = microseconds(100);
883 std::this_thread::sleep_for(nap);
884 }
885}

909u64 CAlphaCPU::pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException reason) const
910{
911 // MMU calls keep their fault-state and lock handling - family vector
912 // is made selection here. GO_PAL uses the complete entry.
913 return pal_exception_entry(reason, state.current_pc).offset;
914}
915
916void CAlphaCPU::enter_pal_exception(const AlphaPALExceptionEntry& entry)
917{
918 state.exc_addr = entry.saved_pc;
919 set_pc(state.pal_base | entry.offset | U64(1));
920 if (entry.clear_lock)
921 cSystem->cpu_clear_lock(state.iProcNum);
922}
923
924void CAlphaCPU::enter_native_call_pal(u32 function)
925{
926 const auto entry = m_profile.pal.call_pal_entry(function, state.current_pc, state.pc);
927 state.exc_addr = entry.saved_pc;
928 if (entry.write_link)
929 state.r[state.sde ? entry.shadow_link_register : entry.link_register] = entry.return_pc;
930 set_pc(state.pal_base | entry.offset);
931}

936CAlphaCPU::CAlphaCPU(CConfigurator* cfg, CSystem* system, const AlphaCPUProfile& profile)
937 : CSystemComponent(cfg, system), m_profile(profile), mySemaphore(0, 1)

944 {
945 char why[64];
946 snprintf(why, sizeof(why), "palcode.vms.nohle set on %s", cfg->get_myName());
947 system->request_native_pal(why);
948 }
949#endif

955void CAlphaCPU::init()
956{
957 memset(&state, 0, sizeof(state));
958 reset_idle_detector();
959 last_dtb_virt[0] = last_dtb_virt[1] = 0;
960 cc_last_read = 0; // rpcc_read floor state tracks state.cc -- reset together
961 cc_borrow = 0;
962 cc_wall_remainder = 0;
963
964 cpu_hz = myCfg->get_num_value("speed", true, 500000000);
965 idle_nap_enabled = myCfg->get_bool_value("idle_nap", false);
966 m_unaligned_fixup = myCfg->get_bool_value("unaligned_fixup", true);
967 load_idle_config();
968 exit_on_pal_halt = myCfg->get_myParent()->get_bool_value("exit_on_pal_halt", false);
969
970 // Instruction-paced interval-timer cap.
971 // Default = 1.25M, the 1024Hz-tick cadence of the fastest Alpha - 1.25GHz EV68)
972 m_max_instr_per_tick = myCfg->get_num_value("timer.max_instr_per_tick", false, 1250000);
973 if (const char* e = getenv("ES40_MAX_INSTR_PER_TICK"))
974 m_max_instr_per_tick = (u64)atoll(e);
975
976 vmspal_lle_enabled = cSystem->native_pal_requested();
977
978 state.iProcNum = cSystem->RegisterCPU(this);
979
980#ifdef ES40_JIT
981 if (m_profile.jit_supported
982 && Ev68InstructionFetch::supports_legacy_jit(m_profile.instruction_fetch))
983 {
984 if (!m_jit) m_jit = new CJitEngine(m_profile, (int)state.iProcNum);
985 m_jit->set_exit_slot(&m_jit_exit);
986 // Tell the JIT the byte offsets (from `this`) of the fields its inline load
987 // fast path reads, so compiled code can address them via [cpu + offset].
988 CJitEngine::JitOffsets o;
989 // Slot [0][0] of the read cache; the inline load adds dpc_index(va)*dpc_stride to reach
990 // the indexed slot, so these are the base (slot 0) field offsets.
991 o.dpc_valid = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].valid - (char*)this);
992 o.dpc_virt_page = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].virt_page - (char*)this);
993 o.dpc_phys_base = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].phys_base - (char*)this);
994 o.dpc_host_bias = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].host_bias - (char*)this);
995 o.dpc_cm = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].cm - (char*)this);
996 o.dpc_asn = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[0][0].asn - (char*)this);
997 o.dpc_stride = (uint32_t)sizeof(data_page_cache[0][0]);
998 o.dpc_mask = (uint32_t)kDpcMask;
999 o.dpc_write_row = (uint32_t)((char*)&data_page_cache[1][0] - (char*)&data_page_cache[0][0]);
1000 o.dpc_bank = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_dpc_bank - (char*)this);
1001 o.dpc_ll_watch_tag = (uint32_t)kDpcLLWatchTag;
1002 o.state_cm = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.cm - (char*)this);
1003 o.jit_mode_bit = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_jit_mode_bit - (char*)this);
1004 o.state_asn0 = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.asn0 - (char*)this);
1005 o.state_asn = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.asn - (char*)this);
1006 o.dram_ptr = (uint32_t)((char*)&dram_ptr - (char*)this);
1007 o.dram_size = (uint32_t)((char*)&dram_size - (char*)this);
1008 o.state_pc = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.pc - (char*)this);
1009 o.state_current_pc = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.current_pc - (char*)this);
1010 o.jit_budget = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_jit_budget - (char*)this);
1011 o.check_int = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.check_int - (char*)this);
1012 o.check_timers = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.check_timers - (char*)this);
1013 o.link_from = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_link_from - (char*)this);
1014 o.jit_exit = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_jit_exit - (char*)this);
1015 o.fpen = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.fpen - (char*)this);
1016 o.exc_sum = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.exc_sum - (char*)this);
1017 o.f_base = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.f[0] - (char*)this);
1018 o.f_from_r = (uint32_t)(offsetof(decltype(state), f) - offsetof(decltype(state), r));
1019 o.fpcr = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.fpcr - (char*)this);
1020 o.exc_addr = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.exc_addr - (char*)this);
1021 o.pal_base = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.pal_base - (char*)this);
1022 o.sde = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.sde - (char*)this);
1023 o.mm_stat = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.mm_stat - (char*)this);
1024 o.fault_va = (uint32_t)((char*)&state.fault_va - (char*)this);
1025 // CPU-resident helper table:
1026 {
1027 const CJitEngine::HelperSet ht = {
1028 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write,
1029 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_opcdec, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mfpr,
1030 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mtpr,
1031 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_indirect,
1032 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_locked, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_stc,
1033 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_misc, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_vpte, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_wchk,
1034 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_itof, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_ftoi,
1035 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltl,
1036 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_write,
1037 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltv };
1038 static_assert(sizeof(ht) == sizeof(m_jit_helper_tab),
1039 "m_jit_helper_tab must match HelperSet exactly (the JIT indexes it as void*[])");
1040 memcpy(m_jit_helper_tab, &ht, sizeof(ht));
1041 o.helpers = (uint32_t)((char*)&m_jit_helper_tab[0] - (char*)this);
1042 }
1043 m_jit->set_offsets(o);
1044 }
1045#endif
1046
1047 state.wait_for_start = (state.iProcNum == 0) ? false : true;
1048 icache_enabled = true;
1049 flush_icache();
1050
1051 tbia(ACCESS_READ);
1052 tbia(ACCESS_EXEC);
1053
1054 if (m_profile.reset.initialize)
1055 m_profile.reset.initialize(*this);
1056
1057#if defined(IDB)
1058 bListing = false;
1059#endif
1060 myThread = 0;
1061
1062 cc_large = 0;
1063 prev_cc = 0;
1064 start_cc = 0;
1065 prev_time = 0;
1066 prev_icount = 0;
1067 start_icount = 0;
1068
1069 start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
1070 next_timer_fire = start_time;
1071
1072#if defined(CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR)
1073 cc_per_instruction = CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR;
1074#else
1075 cc_per_instruction = 70;
1076#endif
1077
1078 dram_ptr = cSystem->PtrToMem(0);
1079 dram_size = U64(1) << cSystem->get_memory_bits();
1080
1081 flush_data_page_cache();
1082
1083 seq_line_ptr = nullptr;
1084 seq_offset = 0;
1085 seq_remaining = 0;
1086 seq_next_pc = 0;
1087
1088 printf("%s(%d): $Id$\n",
1089 devid_string, state.iProcNum);
1090 if (state.iProcNum == 0)
1091 {
1092 if (m_max_instr_per_tick)
1093 printf("%s: interval timer paced to %" PRIu64 " guest instr/tick\n",
1094 devid_string, m_max_instr_per_tick);
1095 else
1096 printf("%s: interval timer wall-clock only (instruction pacing disabled)\n", devid_string);
1097 }
1098}

1100void CAlphaCPU::ResetForSystemReset()

1107 memset(&state, 0, sizeof(state));

1109 last_dtb_virt[0] = last_dtb_virt[1] = 0;

1114
1115 cpu_hz = myCfg->get_num_value("speed", true, 500000000);

1121 if (const char* e = getenv("ES40_MAX_INSTR_PER_TICK"))
1122 m_max_instr_per_tick = (u64)atoll(e);
1123 tick_last_icount = 0;
1124 tick_seen_seq = 0;
1125
1126 state.wait_for_start = (state.iProcNum == 0) ? false : true;
1127 icache_enabled = true;
1128 flush_icache();
1129
1130 tbia(ACCESS_READ);
1131 tbia(ACCESS_EXEC);
1132
1133 if (m_profile.reset.initialize)
1134 m_profile.reset.initialize(*this);
1135
1136 myThread = 0;
1137
1138 cc_large = 0;
1139 prev_cc = 0;
1140 start_cc = 0;
1141 prev_time = 0;
1142 prev_icount = 0;
1143 start_icount = 0;

1145 start_time = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
1146 next_timer_fire = start_time;

1148#if defined(CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR)

1152#endif
1153
1154 dram_ptr = cSystem->PtrToMem(0);
1155 dram_size = U64(1) << cSystem->get_memory_bits();
1156
1157 flush_data_page_cache();
1158
1159 seq_line_ptr = nullptr;
1160 seq_offset = 0;
1161 seq_remaining = 0;
1162 seq_next_pc = 0;

1165void CAlphaCPU::start_threads()
1166{
1167 char buffer[5];
1168 mySemaphore.tryWait(1);
1169 if (!myThread)
1170 {
1171 sprintf(buffer, "cpu%d", state.iProcNum);
1172 myThread = new CThread(buffer);
1173 printf(" %s", myThread->getName().c_str());
1174 StopThread = false;
1175 myThread->setPriority(CThread::PRIO_HIGHEST);
1176 myThread->start(*this);
1177 }
1178}
1179
1180void CAlphaCPU::stop_threads()
1181{
1182 StopThread = true;
1183 wake_idle();
1184 if (myThread)
1185 {
1186 try {
1187 mySemaphore.set();
1188 }
1189 catch (const std::overflow_error&) {
1190 // Already signaled
1191 }
1192 printf(" %s", myThread->getName().c_str());
1193 myThread->join();
1194 delete myThread;
1195 myThread = 0;
1196 }
1197
1198 mySemaphore.tryWait(1);
1199}
1200
1201// ============================================================================
1202//
1203// Alpha FPCR layout (all meaningful bits are in the upper 32 bits):
1204//
1205// 63 SUM - Summary Bit (SUM).
1206// 62 INED - Inexact Disable (INED).
1207// 61 UNFD - Underflow Disable (UNFD)
1208// 60 UNDZ - Underflow to Zero (UNDZ)
1209// 59:58 DYN - Dynamic Rounding Mode (DYN)
1210// 57 IOV - Integer Overflow (IOV)
1211// 56 INE - Inexact Result (INE)
1212// 55 UNF - Underflow (UNF).
1213// 54 OVF - Overflow (OVF)
1214// 53 DZE - Division by Zero (DZE)
1215// 52 INV - Invalid Operation (INV)
1216// 51 OVFD - Overflow Disable (OVFD)
1217// 50 DZED - Division by Zero Disable (DZED)
1218// 49 INVD - Invalid Operation Disable (INVD)
1219// 48 DNZ - Denormal Operands to Zero (DNZ)
1220// 47 DNOD - Denormal Operand Exception Disable (DNOD)
1221// 46:0 Reserved, must be read as zero
1222//
1223// Alpha Architecture Reference Manual, 4th ed. [ARM]:
1224// Section 4.7.8 - Floating-Point Control Register (FPCR)
1225// Section 4.7.8.1 - Accessing the FPCR
1226// Section 4.7.8.2 - Default Values of the FPCR
1227// Section 4.10.4 - Move from/to Floating-Point Control Register
1228// at least according to this one https://download.majix.org/dec/alpha_arch_ref.pdf
1229// ============================================================================
1230
1231u64 CAlphaCPU::read_fpcr_arch() const {
1232 u64 val = state.fpcr & ~(FPCR_RAZ | U64(0x00000000FFFFFFFF));
1233
1234 if (val & FPCR_ERR)
1235 val |= FPCR_SUM;
1236 else
1237 val &= ~FPCR_SUM;
1238
1239 return val;
1240}
1241
1242void CAlphaCPU::write_fpcr_arch(u64 arch_val) {
1243 u64 val = arch_val & ~(FPCR_RAZ | U64(0x00000000FFFFFFFF));
1244
1245 if (val & FPCR_ERR)
1246 val |= FPCR_SUM;
1247 else
1248 val &= ~FPCR_SUM;
1249
1250 state.fpcr = val;
1251}

1337void CAlphaCPU::jit_sampler_start()
1338{
1339 DuplicateHandle(GetCurrentProcess(), GetCurrentThread(), GetCurrentProcess(), &m_host_thread, 0, FALSE, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS);
1340 m_samples = new uint64_t[5u * (1u << 18)];
1341 SymSetOptions(SYMOPT_UNDNAME | SYMOPT_DEFERRED_LOADS);
1342 SymInitialize(GetCurrentProcess(), nullptr, TRUE);
1343 HANDLE h = (HANDLE) m_host_thread;
1344 m_sampler = std::thread([this, h]() {
1345 for (;;)
1346 {
1347 Sleep(1);
1348 if (SuspendThread(h) == (DWORD) -1) continue;
1349 CONTEXT ctx; ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_CONTROL;
1350 if (GetThreadContext(h, &ctx))
1351 {
1352 const uint32_t n = m_nsamples.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
1353 if (n < (1u << 18))
1354 {
1355 uint64_t* rec = &m_samples[5u * n];
1356 rec[0] = ctx.Rip;
1357 SIZE_T got = 0;
1358 if (!ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), (LPCVOID) ctx.Rsp, &rec[1], 4 * sizeof(uint64_t), &got) || got < 4 * sizeof(uint64_t))
1359 rec[1] = rec[2] = rec[3] = rec[4] = 0;
1360 m_nsamples.store(n + 1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
1361 }
1362 }
1363 ResumeThread(h);
1364 }
1365 });
1366 m_sampler.detach();
1367 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] host RIP sampler on (1 kHz)\n", get_cpuid());
1368}
1369
1370void CAlphaCPU::jit_sampler_report()
1371{
1372 const uint32_t n = m_nsamples.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
1373 if (n < 100) return;
1374 std::vector<CJitEngine::HostRange> tab;
1375 m_jit->host_code_table(tab);
1376 std::sort(tab.begin(), tab.end(), [](const CJitEngine::HostRange& a, const CJitEngine::HostRange& b) { return a.start < b.start; });
1377 std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> blk; // block idx -> samples
1378 std::map<uint64_t, uint32_t> blk_off; // (idx<<20 | offset) -> samples
1379 std::map<std::string, uint32_t> sym; // symbol -> samples
1380 std::map<std::string, uint32_t> symc; // symbol <- caller -> samples
1381 uint32_t in_jit = 0, other = 0;
1382 auto name_of = [](uint64_t addr, char* out, size_t cap) -> bool {
1383 char buf[sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO) + 256]; SYMBOL_INFO* si = (SYMBOL_INFO*) buf;
1384 si->SizeOfStruct = sizeof(SYMBOL_INFO); si->MaxNameLen = 255;
1385 DWORD64 disp = 0;
1386 if (!SymFromAddr(GetCurrentProcess(), addr, &disp, si)) return false;
1387 snprintf(out, cap, "%s", si->Name); return true;
1388 };
1389 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
1390 {
1391 const uint64_t* rec = &m_samples[5u * i];
1392 const uint64_t rip = rec[0];
1393 auto it = std::upper_bound(tab.begin(), tab.end(), rip, [](uint64_t v, const CJitEngine::HostRange& r) { return v < r.start; });
1394 if (it != tab.begin() && (--it)->start <= rip && rip < it->start + it->size)
1395 {
1396 in_jit++; blk[it->idx]++; blk_off[((uint64_t) it->idx << 20) | (rip - it->start)]++;
1397 continue;
1398 }
1399 other++;
1400 char nm[256];
1401 if (!name_of(rip, nm, sizeof(nm))) snprintf(nm, sizeof(nm), "?%llx", (unsigned long long) (rip >> 12));
1402 sym[nm]++;
1403 char caller[256] = "?";
1404 for (int k = 1; k <= 4; ++k) // first stack word that names a different function
1405 {
1406 char c[256];
1407 if (rec[k] && name_of(rec[k], c, sizeof(c)) && strcmp(c, nm) != 0) { snprintf(caller, sizeof(caller), "%s", c); break; }
1408 }
1409 char key[520]; snprintf(key, sizeof(key), "%s <- %s", nm, caller);
1410 symc[key]++;
1411 }
1412 m_nsamples.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
1413 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] %u samples: JIT code %.1f%% | C++ %.1f%%\n", get_cpuid(), n, 100.0 * in_jit / n, 100.0 * other / n);
1414 std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, std::string>> rows;
1415 for (auto& kv : sym) rows.push_back({ kv.second, kv.first });
1416 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](auto& a, auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });
1417 for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size() && i < 14; ++i)
1418 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] %5.1f%% %s\n", get_cpuid(), 100.0 * rows[i].first / n, rows[i].second.c_str());
1419 rows.clear();
1420 for (auto& kv : symc) rows.push_back({ kv.second, kv.first });
1421 std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](auto& a, auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });
1422 for (size_t i = 0; i < rows.size() && i < 10; ++i)
1423 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] %5.1f%% %s\n", get_cpuid(), 100.0 * rows[i].first / n, rows[i].second.c_str());
1424 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] dpc: %llu flushes | helper misses empty %llu, conflict %llu, cm/asn %llu\n", get_cpuid(),
1425 (unsigned long long) m_dpc_flushes, (unsigned long long) m_dpc_miss[0], (unsigned long long) m_dpc_miss[1], (unsigned long long) m_dpc_miss[2]);
1426 m_dpc_flushes = 0; m_dpc_miss[0] = m_dpc_miss[1] = m_dpc_miss[2] = 0;
1427 std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> brows;
1428 for (auto& kv : blk) brows.push_back({ kv.second, kv.first });
1429 std::sort(brows.begin(), brows.end(), [](auto& a, auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });
1430 for (size_t i = 0; i < brows.size() && i < 12; ++i)
1431 {
1432 const CJitEngine::JitBlock& b = m_jit->block_at(brows[i].second);
1433 printf("[JIT][SAMPLER][CPU%d] %5.1f%% block tag=%016llx prefix=%u csz=%u offs:", get_cpuid(), 100.0 * brows[i].first / n,
1434 (unsigned long long) b.tag, b.prefix_len, b.rp_csz);
1435 std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> offs;
1436 for (auto& kv : blk_off) if ((uint32_t) (kv.first >> 20) == brows[i].second) offs.push_back({ kv.second, (uint32_t) (kv.first & 0xfffff) });
1437 std::sort(offs.begin(), offs.end(), [](auto& a, auto& b) { return a.first > b.first; });
1438 for (size_t k = 0; k < offs.size() && k < 6; ++k) printf(" +%x(%u)", offs[k].second, offs[k].first);
1439 printf("\n");
1440 }
1441}
1442#endif
1443
1444void CAlphaCPU::jit_flush_blocks()
1445{
1446 if (m_jit)
1447 m_jit->flush();
1448}
1449
1450// ASM-bit-clear icache flush (process/ASN switch, ITB_IAP): keep the global PAL blocks compiled
1451// instead of recompiling them on every such flush (the dominant JIT cost in PAL-heavy code).
1452void CAlphaCPU::jit_flush_blocks_asm()
1453{
1454 if (m_jit)
1455 m_jit->flush_non_global();
1456}
1457
1458void CAlphaCPU::jit_run(int budget)
1459{
1460 if (budget <= 0)
1461 return;
1462 CSystem::JitExecutionGuard execution(cSystem, state.iProcNum);
1463 // CPU registration is complete by execution time, unlike construction of
1464 // CPU0's JIT. SMP stores must use the shared RAM reservation protocol.
1465 if (m_jit) m_jit->set_smp_memory(cSystem->get_cpu_num() > 1, cSystem->ll_buckets(),
1466 cSystem->ll_watch_data());
1467
1468 // Relative to the caller's budget, so no magic number here.
1469 if (m_jit && idle_rule != RULE_NONE && idle_spin_min_instr == 0)
1470 idle_spin_min_instr = (u64) budget * 3 / 4;
1471
1472 if (m_jit) m_jit->reclaim_if_pending(); // deferred code reclaim, here at a safe point (no compiled frame live)
1473 const auto batch_now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
1474 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(g_diag_excluded_ns); // keep device-diagnostic print stalls out of the RPCC (diag_rpcc.h)
1475 g_diag_excluded_ns = 0;
1476 // Wall-clock RPCC: advance the cycle counter by real elapsed time * cpu_hz (when enabled) so
1477 // it tracks the configured CPU frequency no matter how fast/bursty the JIT runs. The helper
1478 // caps (not drops) odd deltas at 1s: dropping made the cc run slow through early-boot
1479 // device-init stalls, and SRM's cycles-per-tick calibration locked that in as a
1480 // too-low CPU speed (the 357MHz bug).
1481 sync_cc_wallclock();
1482
1483 service_interval_timer(batch_now);
1484
1485 // Instruction-paced interval-tick envelope, for EVERY CPU.
1486 // Gated off for the firmware/VMS PALcode (base 0x8000, and the pre-PAL reset state):
1487 // SRM runs under it, and SRM's per-CPU speed calibration counts cycles
1488 // per tick in a tight spin. NT and OSF-style PALcodes load at other bases and are paced.
1489 // A CPU that retires the envelope before the wall-clock tick is due shall sleep until
1490 // the correct tick time, the cpu should never receive early/extra.
1491 // The RPCC/cycle counter is unaffected (it stays wall-clock accurate via sync_cc_wallclock).
1492 const u64 pace_period_ns = (m_max_instr_per_tick && theAli && state.pal_base && state.pal_base != U64(0x8000))
1493 ? theAli->get_interval_period_ns() : 0; // 0 = pacing off, or the guest hasn't programmed the tick yet
1494 if (pace_period_ns)
1495 {
1496 const u64 ic = state.instruction_count;
1497 const u32 seq = cSystem->get_tick_seq();
1498 if (seq != tick_seen_seq)
1499 {
1500 tick_seen_seq = seq;
1501 tick_last_icount = ic;
1502 }
1503 else if ((ic - tick_last_icount) >= m_max_instr_per_tick)
1504 {
1505 switch (tick_hold(pace_period_ns))
1506 {
1507 case TickHold::Ticked: // landed, or CPU0 fires it on re-entry: the window re-opens there
1508 return;
1509 case TickHold::Expired: // secondary, CPU0 late: re-open the window rather than starve
1510 tick_last_icount = ic;
1511 break;
1512 case TickHold::Doorbell: // interrupt/stop/reset: run this batch, hold again next entry
1513 break;
1514 }
1515 }
1516 }
1517
1518 // A profile or fetch contract without JIT support uses the same clock/timer
1519 // dispatch envelope, without discovering blocks through the legacy source path.
1520 if (!m_jit)
1521 {
1522 while (budget > 0)
1523 {
1524 // LoadROM also steps after reset, before start_threads clears StopThread.
1525 if ((myThread && StopThread) || (cSystem && cSystem->IsSystemResetRequested()))
1526 break;
1527 execute(); // One instruction attempt per call in an ES40_JIT build.
1528 --budget; // Fetch faults still consume an attempt.
1529 }
1530 return;
1531 }
1532
1533 const auto sources = instruction_sources();
1534 while (budget > 0)
1535 {
1536 // Wake CPUs napping on a line this CPU's last chain stored to.
1537 cSystem->idle_watch_poll(state.iProcNum);
1538 const u64 start_virt = state.pc;
1539 const u32 start_asn = (u32)state.asn;
1540 const bool start_pal_shadow = (start_virt & 1) && state.sde;
1541
1542 if (m_profile.instruction_fetch.prepare_dispatch)
1543 m_profile.instruction_fetch.prepare_dispatch(*this);
1544
1545 // Host-side idle detection (JIT only, off by default). A qualifying
1546 // sample follows at least 3/4 of the initial dispatch budget's work;
1547 // repeated PCs suggest a loop, but do not prove that it is idle.
1548 // The VMS rule samples IPL here, not throughout the preceding work.
1549 // False positives can repeatedly delay useful computation. Each nap
1550 // requests at most 1ms, bounded by the next timer deadline, and is
1551 // interruptible; host scheduling can still return late.
1552 if (idle_rule != RULE_NONE)
1553 idle_detect_sample(start_virt, sources);
1554
1555 // Observe the family's mapping without fetching or faulting. The legacy JIT
1556 // still uses the physical identity to validate its DRAM-backed compiled blocks.
1557 const auto source = probe_instruction_source(start_virt);
1558 const u64 start_phys = source.physical;
1559 const bool start_asm = source.asm_global;
1560 const bool have_phys = source.valid;
1561
1562 // Trace segments are native addresses. Preserve their existing alignment
1563 // while using the same family probe as the dispatcher.
1564 auto live_exec_phys = [&](u64 v, u64* op) -> bool {
1565 const auto mapping = probe_instruction_source(v & ~U64(3));
1566 if (!mapping.valid) return false;
1567 *op = mapping.physical;
1568 return true;
1569 };
1570
1571 // Trace tier: gated lookup BEFORE the block cache. In non-debug release a hot trace runs
1572 // straight through and side-exits back here with state.pc set, then `continue`; the block
1573 // cache stays the universal fallback. Under JIT_VERIFY the production run is gated OFF,
1574 // traces still FORM (below), but they're exercised + compared inside the block verify (next
1575 // stage) rather than driving execution unchecked.
1576#if !defined(JIT_VERIFY) && defined(JIT_TRACES)
1577 // Same run-gates as the block path below: a compiled trace has no per-instruction interrupt
1578 // poll, so DON'T enter it while an interrupt/timer is pending (the interpreter must service it,
1579 // or the CPU livelocks -> OS sanity-timer bugcheck), nor a PALmode trace without SDE, nor one
1580 // that would overrun the budget. JIT_TRACES-off builds compile the whole hook away.
1581 auto trace_segs_live = [&](CJitEngine::TraceFragment* tf) -> bool {
1582 // The head's live phys is checked by trace_ok; re-resolve each INTERIOR segment too. An interior
1583 // page remapped to a different physical with IDENTICAL bytes is invisible to the source hash.
1584 for (uint32_t s = 1; s < tf->n_segs; ++s) { u64 sp; if (!live_exec_phys(tf->segs[s].guest_pc, &sp) || sp != tf->segs[s].phys_pc) { m_jit->note_trace_stale(); return false; } }
1585 return true;
1586 };
1587 if (have_phys && !(start_virt & 1) && m_jit->traces_enabled()
1588 && !state.check_int && !state.check_timers)
1589 {
1590 CJitEngine::TraceFragment* t = m_jit->trace_lookup(start_virt, start_asn);
1591 if (t && t->underrun >= 64) { m_jit->demote_trace(t); t = nullptr; } // R3b: stopped looping -> net tax
1592 if (t && (int)t->n_instr <= budget && (!(t->head_tag & 1) || state.sde)
1593 && m_jit->trace_ok(t, start_phys, sources) && trace_segs_live(t))
1594 {
1595 // chain-in: a predecessor's exit missed here and the trace is validated (vgen just
1596 // re-stamped) -- patch its slots with the trace's chained entry so the edge lands
1597 // in-frame next time. Hook-before-block ordering makes traces win the patch.
1598 if (m_link_from && t->chain_entry) { m_jit->note_link_bail();
1599 m_jit->patch_edge(m_link_from, t->head_tag, t->vgen, t->chain_entry, t->asm_global);
1600 m_link_from = nullptr; }
1601 m_jit_budget = budget; // ceiling for the trace (its loads/bails honor it like a block)
1602#ifdef JIT_STATS
1603 const uint64_t _trace_t0 = jit_rdtsc();
1604#endif
1605 dpc_sync_bank();
1606 const u32 done = ((CJitEngine::JitFn)t->code)(this, &state.r[0]);
1607#ifdef JIT_STATS
1608 const uint64_t _trace_tsc = jit_rdtsc() - _trace_t0;
1609#endif
1610 state.r[31] = 0;
1611 break_seq_icache(); // the trace wrote state.pc natively; drop the stale cursor
1612 state.instruction_count += done;
1613 cc_large += (u64)done * cc_per_instruction;
1614 budget -= done;
1615#ifdef JIT_STATS
1616 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->note_exec(done, 0, _trace_tsc, 0));
1617 m_jit->trace_entered();
1618 if (done < (u32)t->n_instr) m_jit->trace_exited(); // ran fewer than the trace's first-pass span -> a side-exit/underrun
1619#endif
1620 if (done > 0) continue; // progress: re-dispatch at the trace's exit PC
1621 }
1622 }
1623#endif
1624
1625 // Hot path: virtual+ASN lookup, phys-validated (skipped on a translation miss).
1626 CJitEngine::JitBlock* b = have_phys
1627 ? m_jit->lookup(start_virt, start_asn, start_pal_shadow) : nullptr;
1628 if (have_phys && !b) // lazy-flushed survivor? hash-revalidate in place (no interpreted pass)
1629 b = m_jit->revalidate_flushed(start_virt, start_asn, start_pal_shadow,
1630 start_phys, sources);
1631
1632 // A valid block whose phys no longer matches = a page remap the virtual key can't see.
1633 // The cold path below re-records it; log it -- it's the smoking gun for stale-chain bugs.
1634 if (b && b->code && b->phys != start_phys)
1635 {
1636 static int n_stale = 0;
1637 if (n_stale++ < 20)
1638 printf("[JIT][CPU%d] DISPATCH STALE: pc=%016llx block_phys=%016llx live_phys=%016llx\n",
1639 (int)state.iProcNum, (unsigned long long) start_virt,
1640 (unsigned long long) b->phys, (unsigned long long) start_phys);
1641 }
1642
1643 // Run the compiled safe prefix natively when available. A pending interrupt
1644 // is deliverable only outside PALmode (execute() applies the same rule), while
1645 // delayed timers still require the interpreter's per-instruction poll.
1646 if (b && b->code && b->phys == start_phys && (int)b->prefix_len <= budget
1647 && (!state.check_int || (b->tag & 1)) && !state.check_timers
1648 && (!(b->tag & 1) || b->pal_shadow == (bool)state.sde))
1649 {
1650 b->vgen = m_jit->vgen(); // phys validated + lookup proved flush-fresh: refresh the chain epoch
1651 m_jit->authorize_native(b, (uint32_t)state.cm);
1652#ifdef JIT_TRACES
1653 // after a block has dispatched 8x, promote it to a single-block trace (a
1654 // future trace head). Dispatch-counted for now -- it undercounts chained loops, but they
1655 // still surface here when a chain breaks
1656 if (!(b->tag & 1) && m_jit->traces_enabled() && ++b->hot == 8
1657 && !m_jit->trace_lookup(start_virt, start_asn))
1658 {
1659 const CJitEngine::HelperSet hs = {
1660 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write,
1661 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_opcdec, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mfpr,
1662 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mtpr,
1663 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_indirect,
1664 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_locked, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_stc,
1665 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_misc, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_vpte, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_wchk,
1666 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_itof, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_ftoi,
1667 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltl,
1668 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_write,
1669 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltv };
1670 // Loop/superblock FUSION: follow each block's STATIC taken branch target, growing the trace,
1671 // until the chain branches back to the head (compile_trace then closes the loop) or hits a
1672 // non-branch / non-live target / a non-head cycle / the segment cap. Works under verify too
1673 // (b->link is only set by production chaining).
1674 //
1675 // form LOOP traces only -- a closed back-edge is the one shape with an advantage
1676 // over block chains (in-trace iteration + the spike's per-trace pins).
1677 //
1678 // Linear traces duplicated block work (I-cache) and varying-successor heads (DCL
1679 // dispatch) formed pure side-exit taxes. Non-closing heads pay this scan once (hot
1680 // fires at exactly 8) and never re-form.
1681 static constexpr bool TraceLoopsOnly = true;
1682 CJitEngine::JitBlock* blist[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs] = { b };
1683 u32 nb = 1;
1684 bool closes = false;
1685 // link-guided fusion: computed jumps (0x1a JMP/JSR/RET only -- no mode/state
1686 // change) follow the block's own hottest OBSERVED successor; the inter-block guard
1687 // (R10 == fused tag) is exactly the return-address speculation check. Lets loops
1688 // containing calls close (the common real-world hot-loop shape).
1689 static constexpr bool TraceLinkFusion = true;
1690 for (CJitEngine::JitBlock* cur = b; nb < CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs; ) {
1691 u32 lop;
1692 if (!cur->prefix_len || !sources.read_word(cur->tag, cur->phys,
1693 cur->asm_global, cur->prefix_len - 1, lop)) break;
1694 const u32 lopc = lop >> 26;
1695 u64 spc = 0;
1696 if (lopc >= 0x38 && lopc <= 0x3f) {
1697 // A conditional's static target is often the loop exit.
1698 // Prefer the successor this block exit took most recently
1699 // fall back to the static edge before linking.
1700 for (int li = 0; li < CJitEngine::kLinkSlots; ++li)
1701 if (cur->link[li].body) { spc = cur->link[li].tag; break; }
1702 if (!spc) {
1703 const int64_t disp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)(lop & 0x1FFFFF) << 43) >> 43;
1704 spc = (((cur->tag & ~U64(1)) + 4 * (u64)(cur->prefix_len - 1)) + 4 + (u64)(disp * 4)) | (cur->tag & 1);
1705 }
1706 } else if (lopc == 0x30 || lopc == 0x34) { // unconditional PC-relative target
1707 const int64_t disp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)(lop & 0x1FFFFF) << 43) >> 43;
1708 spc = (((cur->tag & ~U64(1)) + 4 * (u64)(cur->prefix_len - 1)) + 4 + (u64)(disp * 4)) | (cur->tag & 1);
1709 } else if (TraceLinkFusion && lopc == 0x1a) {
1710 for (int li = 0; li < CJitEngine::kLinkSlots; ++li)
1711 if (cur->link[li].body) { spc = cur->link[li].tag; break; }
1712 if (!spc || (spc & 1) != (cur->tag & 1)) break; // no observed successor / mode change
1713 } else break; // breaker terminator: don't cross
1714 if (spc == b->tag) { closes = true; break; } // back-edge to the head -> compile_trace closes the loop
1715 CJitEngine::JitBlock* succ = m_jit->lookup(spc, start_asn, false);
1716 if (!succ || succ == b || !succ->code || succ->prefix_len == 0) break;
1717 u64 sp; if (!live_exec_phys(spc, &sp) || sp != succ->phys) break; // successor remapped since compile -> stale, don't fuse
1718 bool dup = false; for (u32 j = 0; j < nb; ++j) if (blist[j] == succ) { dup = true; break; }
1719 if (dup) break;
1720 blist[nb++] = succ; cur = succ;
1721 }
1722 if (!TraceLoopsOnly || closes)
1723 {
1724 // Compilation can replace the trace that owns this pending exit cache.
1725 // Don't publish link with its previous source identity.
1726 m_link_from = nullptr;
1727 m_jit->compile_trace(m_jit->trace_slot(start_virt), blist, nb, sources, hs);
1728 }
1729 }
1730#endif // JIT_TRACES
1731#ifdef JIT_VERIFY
1732 // Interpret the prefix (authoritative), recording each loaded value so the
1733 // compiled pass can replay it instead of re-reading memory. Skip the compare
1734 // if an interrupt/trap diverts us mid-prefix.
1735 u64 snap[64]; // 64: capture the PALshadow bank (r32..r63) for PALmode blocks
1736 memcpy(snap, state.r, sizeof(snap));
1737 u64 f_pre[64]; // FP file before the interp pass -- restored before the compiled pass below
1738 memcpy(f_pre, state.f, sizeof(f_pre)); // so the compiled FP ops read the same f[] the interp did
1739 // I_CTL/CM/SIRR + PCTX fields (HW_MFPR 0x40-7f reads astrr/aster/fpen/ppcen) are read-modify-written; a HW_MFPR reads, a later HW_MTPR writes,
1740 // so the interp pass writes before the compiled pass's HW_MFPR reads. Snapshot the read-back
1741 // fields here and restore them before b->code() below -- like snap/f_pre do for GPRs/FP.
1742 const bool ictl_sde_pre = state.sde, ictl_hwe_pre = state.hwe;
1743 const int ictl_spe_pre = state.i_ctl_spe, ictl_vam_pre = state.i_ctl_va_mode;
1744 const u64 ictl_vptb_pre = state.i_ctl_vptb, ictl_other_pre = state.i_ctl_other;
1745 const int cm_pre = state.cm, sir_pre = state.sir; // CM/SIRR read-back (HW_MFPR CM/SIRR)
1746 const int aster_pre = state.aster, astrr_pre = state.astrr; // AST/FPEN/PPCEN read-back via the
1747 const int fpen_pre = state.fpen, ppcen_pre = state.ppcen; // PCTX group (HW_MFPR 0x40-7f)
1748 // EXC_SUM REG[12:8] (HRM 5.2.13) reports the trapping op's dest register -- report state,
1749 // not execution state, and which pass recorded it differs benignly. Compare the exception
1750 // bits strictly, mask the REG field.
1751 auto ipr_ne = [](int ii, u64 x, u64 y) {
1752 if (ii == 13) { x &= ~U64(0x1f00); y &= ~U64(0x1f00); }
1753 return x != y;
1754 };
1755 const u64 exc_sum_pre = state.exc_sum, fpcr_pre = state.fpcr; // restored before the TRACE pass:
1756 // boundary compares need the pre-span
1757 // value, not the interp's inherited final
1758 // HW_MTPR verify: a compiled block writes IPR fields directly in LIVE state (its GPR
1759 // writes go to jr scratch). cap_iprs snapshots the writable IPR set (the per-boundary
1760 // snapshots below and the post-pass compares both use it); put_iprs restores it. Mostly
1761 // pure stores; I_CTL is read-modify-written, so it's also reset pre-pass (ictl_*_pre,
1762 // above). Keep this list in sync with jit_hw_mtpr.
1763 auto cap_iprs = [&](u64* d) {
1764 d[0] = state.last_tb_virt; d[1] = last_dtb_virt[0]; d[2] = last_dtb_virt[1];
1765 d[3] = state.pctr_ctl; d[4] = state.dc_ctl; d[5] = (u64)state.cc_offset; d[6] = (u64)(u32)state.alt_cm;
1766 // IER enables; check_int not snapshotted (rolling it back could suppress a poll)
1767 d[7] = (u64)(u32)state.asten; d[8] = (u64)(u32)state.sien; d[9] = (u64)(u32)state.pcen;
1768 d[10] = (u64)(u32)state.cren; d[11] = (u64)(u32)state.slen; d[12] = (u64)(u32)state.eien;
1769 d[13] = state.exc_sum; // FPSTART clears it (compiled ITOFx/FTOIx/FLTL)
1770 d[14] = state.fpcr; // MT_FPCR (compiled FLTL) writes it
1771 d[15] = (u64)state.sde; d[16] = (u64)state.hwe; // I_CTL (compiled as terminator)
1772 d[17] = (u64)(u32)state.i_ctl_spe; d[18] = (u64)(u32)state.i_ctl_va_mode;
1773 d[19] = state.i_ctl_vptb; d[20] = state.i_ctl_other;
1774 d[21] = (u64)(u32)state.cm; d[22] = (u64)(u32)state.sir; // CM, SIRR
1775 d[23] = (u64)(u32)state.aster; d[24] = (u64)(u32)state.astrr; // 0x40-group ASTER/ASTRR
1776 d[25] = (u64)(u32)state.fpen; d[26] = (u64)(u32)state.ppcen; // 0x40-group FPEN/PPCEN
1777 };
1778 auto put_iprs = [&](const u64* s) {
1779 state.last_tb_virt = s[0]; last_dtb_virt[0] = s[1]; last_dtb_virt[1] = s[2];
1780 state.pctr_ctl = s[3]; state.dc_ctl = s[4]; state.cc_offset = (u32)s[5]; state.alt_cm = (int)s[6];
1781 state.asten = (int)s[7]; state.sien = (int)s[8]; state.pcen = (int)s[9];
1782 state.cren = (int)s[10]; state.slen = (int)s[11]; state.eien = (int)s[12];
1783 state.exc_sum = s[13];
1784 state.fpcr = s[14];
1785 state.sde = (bool)s[15]; state.hwe = (bool)s[16];
1786 state.i_ctl_spe = (int)s[17]; state.i_ctl_va_mode = (int)s[18];
1787 state.i_ctl_vptb = s[19]; state.i_ctl_other = s[20];
1788 state.cm = (int)s[21]; state.sir = (int)s[22];
1789 flush_data_page_cache();
1790 state.aster = (int)s[23]; state.astrr = (int)s[24];
1791 state.fpen = (int)s[25]; state.ppcen = (int)s[26];
1792 };
1793 // Side-exit-shaped verify: snapshot the interp reference at EVERY fused-block boundary it
1794 // crosses, so a compiled trace/region that legitimately exits early is compared AT ITS EXIT
1795 // instead of being flagged as mismatch. Today's verify traces have no interior gates, so the
1796 // early-exit compare is dormant scaffolding the region will light up.
1797 u32 n_bnd = 0;
1798 u32 bnd_cnt[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs]; // cumulative interp instr count at boundary
1799 u32 bnd_vn[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs]; // interp load-log cursor at boundary
1800 u32 bnd_sn[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs]; // interp store-log cursor at boundary
1801 u64 bnd_pc[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs]; // interp pc at boundary (the resume PC)
1802 u64 bnd_r[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs][64]; // GPRs incl. PALshadow bank
1803 u64 bnd_f[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs][64]; // FP file
1804 u64 bnd_ipr[CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs][27]; // cap_iprs set
1805 u32 source_words[16] = {}; // observed backing words, copied before execution
1806 u32 verify_words[16] = {}; // actual reference instructions for mismatch diagnostics
1807 u32 vn = 0; // loads recorded for replay
1808 u32 sn = 0; // stores recorded for the compiled-pass compare
1809 u64 vpc = start_virt;
1810 u32 cur_len = b->prefix_len; // current interpreted block's length + start tag; step 3
1811 u64 cur_tag = b->tag; // advances these per segment across a fused trace
1812 u64 cur_source = b->phys;
1813 bool cur_asm = b->asm_global;
1814 u32 n_interp = 0; // ops the interp ran over the trace's fused span (vs t->code's done)
1815 bool clean = true;
1816 CJitEngine::TraceFragment* vtr = m_jit->traces_enabled() ? m_jit->trace_lookup(start_virt, start_asn) : nullptr;
1817 if (vtr && !m_jit->trace_ok(vtr, start_phys, sources)) vtr = nullptr; // stale -> verify as a plain block
1818 const u32 nseg = vtr ? vtr->n_segs : 1; // interp the trace's full fused span; else just block b
1819 for (u32 seg = 0; seg < nseg && clean; ++seg) {
1820 if (vtr) { cur_len = vtr->segs[seg].n_instr; cur_tag = vtr->segs[seg].guest_pc;
1821 cur_source = vtr->segs[seg].phys_pc; cur_asm = vtr->segs[seg].asm_global; vpc = cur_tag; }
1822 for (u32 k = 0; k < cur_len; ++k)
1823 {
1824 // Compute the load's effective address from the live registers BEFORE
1825 // executing it (Rb may be the load's own dest), to compare against the JIT.
1826 // SRM copies over this code while its original instructions remain in the
1827 // icache until IMB. Classify the word execute() will fetch, not the changed
1828 // DRAM word, or a cached HW_ST can disappear from the reference store log.
1829 // This is a read-only peek: a miss is still fetched/translated by execute().
1830 u32 ins;
1831 if (!sources.read_word(cur_tag, cur_source, cur_asm, k, ins))
1832 {
1833 // No reliable candidate to classify. Preserve interpreted progress,
1834 // including a first-step fetch fault, and skip this comparison.
1835 execute();
1836 --budget;
1837 clean = false;
1838 break;
1839 }
1840 if (n_interp + k < 16) source_words[n_interp + k] = ins;
1841 peek_cached_instruction(&ins);
1842 if (n_interp + k < 16) verify_words[n_interp + k] = ins;
1843 const u32 opc = ins >> 26;
1844 const int lra = (ins >> 21) & 0x1F;
1845 // Replay the family-selected compiled loads using their original address.
1846 const auto hw_load = (opc == 0x1b)
1847 ? alpha_decode_hw_load(m_profile.hw_load, ins) : AlphaHWLoadDescriptor{};
1848 const bool is_hwld = (opc == 0x1b) && alpha_hw_load_compilable(hw_load);
1849 // RPCC/RC/RS (MISC 0x18) and family-marked IPRs read CPU state the verify can't
1850 // re-derive; the compiled forms pull their value from this same load log (jit_misc /
1851 // jit_hw_mfpr replay it), so log them like loads.
1852 const u32 miscfn = (ins & 0xFFFF);
1853 // Compiled misc reads: RC/RS (0xE000/0xF000) for all Ra incl. 31 (the flag-only side-effect
1854 // forms compile too); RPCC (0xC000) only when it has a GPR dest (Ra!=31).
1855 const bool is_miscrd = (opc == 0x18) && (miscfn == 0xE000 || miscfn == 0xF000 || (miscfn == 0xC000 && lra != 31));
1856 const auto ipr_read = (opc == 0x19)
1857 ? m_profile.ipr_read.describe(ins) : AlphaIPRReadDescriptor{};
1858 const bool is_ipr_replay = (opc == 0x19) && ipr_read.replay
1859 && (lra != 31 || !ipr_read.discard_safe);
1860 const bool is_fpld = (opc == 0x22 || opc == 0x23 || opc == 0x20 || opc == 0x21); // LDS/LDT/LDF/LDG: dest is f[lra]
1861 // Ordinary loads log only with a destination. Stateful misc/IPR reads log
1862 // even to R31 when the compiled helper must consume a replay slot.
1863 const bool isld = ((opc == 0x28 || opc == 0x29 || opc == 0x0a || opc == 0x0c
1864 || opc == 0x2a || opc == 0x2b || opc == 0x0b || is_hwld || is_fpld) && lra != 31)
1865 || is_miscrd || is_ipr_replay; // +LDBU/LDWU +LDx_L +LDQ_U +RPCC/RC/RS +ISUM +LDS/LDT
1866 u64 eva = 0;
1867 if (isld && !is_miscrd && !is_ipr_replay) // misc/ISUM reads have no effective address -- only a logged value
1868 {
1869 const int lrb = (ins >> 16) & 0x1F;
1870 const int ldisp = is_hwld ? hw_load.displacement
1871 : (int)(int16_t)(ins & 0xFFFF); // LDx: 16-bit
1872 eva = (lrb == 31 ? (u64)0 : state.r[RREG(lrb)]) + (u64)ldisp;
1873 if (opc == 0x0b) eva &= ~U64(7); // LDQ_U: address forced to 8-byte alignment
1874 }
1875 // Stores touch memory, not GPRs, so record (addr,value) for the compiled-pass
1876 // compare. Ra (lra) is the value source; Rb is the base. Hardware stores
1877 // use the family-selected compiled forms and original physical address.
1878 const bool is_sc = (opc == 0x2e || opc == 0x2f); // STL_C/STQ_C: store-conditional (success in Ra)
1879 const auto hw_store = (opc == 0x1f)
1880 ? alpha_decode_hw_store(m_profile.hw_store, ins) : AlphaHWStoreDescriptor{};
1881 const bool is_hwst = (opc == 0x1f) && alpha_hw_store_compilable(hw_store);
1882 const bool is_fpst = (opc == 0x26 || opc == 0x27 || opc == 0x24 || opc == 0x25); // STS/STT/STF/STG: value source is f[lra]
1883 const bool isst = (opc == 0x2c || opc == 0x2d || opc == 0x0d || opc == 0x0e || opc == 0x0f || is_sc || is_hwst || is_fpst); // +STx_C +STQ_U +STS/STT
1884 u64 sva = 0, sval = 0;
1885 if (isst)
1886 {
1887 const int srb = (ins >> 16) & 0x1F;
1888 const int sdisp = is_hwst ? hw_store.displacement
1889 : (int)(int16_t)(ins & 0xFFFF); // STx: 16-bit
1890 sva = (srb == 31 ? (u64)0 : state.r[RREG(srb)]) + (u64)sdisp;
1891 if (opc == 0x0f) sva &= ~U64(7); // STQ_U: address forced to 8-byte alignment
1892 if (is_fpst) sval = (opc == 0x27) ? state.f[lra] : (opc == 0x26) ? (u64)ieee_sts(state.f[lra])
1893 : (opc == 0x24) ? (u64)vax_stf(state.f[lra]) : vax_stg(state.f[lra]); // STT/STS/STF/STG
1894 else sval = (lra == 31 ? (u64)0 : state.r[RREG(lra)]);
1895 }
1896 // Capture the computed target before execute() can change its source state.
1897 u64 jtgt = 0;
1898 bool jtgt_valid = false;
1899 if (opc == 0x1a || opc == 0x1e)
1900 {
1901 const int jrb = (ins >> 16) & 0x1F;
1902 const u64 source = jrb == 31 ? (u64)0 : state.r[RREG(jrb)];
1903 if (opc == 0x1e)
1904 {
1905 const auto entry = alpha_pal_return_descriptor(m_profile.pal, ins);
1906 jtgt = alpha_pal_return_target(entry, source, state.exc_addr);
1907 jtgt_valid = alpha_pal_return_valid(entry);
1908 }
1909 else
1910 {
1911 jtgt = (source & ~U64(3)) | (cur_tag & 3);
1912 jtgt_valid = true;
1913 }
1914 }
1915 execute();
1916 --budget;
1917 vpc += 4;
1918 if (state.pc != vpc) {
1919 // The terminator (a compiled branch at the last index) diverges to its
1920 // target -- expected. But execute() services an async interrupt/trap at the
1921 // TOP, before the instruction runs, so the interpreter can divert to a PAL
1922 // handler at the terminator WITHOUT executing the branch. Accept the
1923 // divergence only when state.pc is the branch's actual target; otherwise it's
1924 // an interrupt/trap and the compiled block (which doesn't model interrupts --
1925 // the dispatcher's !check_int guard handles that) legitimately differs, so
1926 // skip the compare instead of flagging a false mismatch.
1927 bool ok_branch = false;
1928 if (k == cur_len - 1 &&
1929 (opc == 0x30 || opc == 0x34 || (opc >= 0x38 && opc <= 0x3f)))
1930 {
1931 const int64_t bdisp = (int64_t)((uint64_t)(ins & 0x1FFFFF) << 43) >> 43;
1932 const u64 tgt = vpc + (u64)(bdisp * 4); // vpc == branch_pc + 4 (fall-through)
1933 ok_branch = (state.pc == tgt);
1934 }
1935 else if (k == cur_len - 1 && (opc == 0x1a || opc == 0x1e))
1936 {
1937 ok_branch = jtgt_valid && (state.pc == jtgt); // selected computed return/jump target
1938 }
1939 else if (k == cur_len - 1 && opc == 0x00)
1940 {
1941 // CALL_PAL vectored to its PALcode entry (pal_base | offset); the kernel-mode
1942 // path never traps, but accept the OPCDEC vector too.
1943 const u32 func = ins & 0x1FFFFFFF;
1944 const u64 voff = m_profile.pal.call_pal_entry(func, vpc - 4, vpc).offset;
1945 ok_branch = (state.pc == (state.pal_base | voff)) || (state.pc == (state.pal_base | pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::OpcodeDecode) | U64(1)));
1946 }
1947 if (!ok_branch)
1948 clean = false;
1949 break;
1950 }
1951 if (isld && vn < kJitVlogCap)
1952 {
1953 m_jit_vaddr[vn] = eva;
1954 m_jit_vlog[vn] = is_fpld ? state.f[lra] : state.r[RREG(lra)]; // FP dest -> f[]; shadow-aware GPR otherwise
1955 vn++;
1956 }
1957 if (isst && sn < kJitVlogCap)
1958 {
1959 m_jit_slog_addr[sn] = sva;
1960 m_jit_slog_val[sn] = sval;
1961 m_jit_slog_success[sn] = is_sc ? state.r[RREG(lra)] : (u64)1; // STx_C result (post-execute); ordinary store = 1
1962 sn++;
1963 }
1964 }
1965 if (!clean) break; // fault/divergence in this segment -> stop (compare skipped)
1966 n_interp += cur_len; // this segment ran fully
1967 if (vtr && n_bnd < CJitEngine::kMaxTraceSegs) {
1968 // Side-exit-shaped verify: capture the reference AT this fused-block boundary.
1969 bnd_cnt[n_bnd] = n_interp; bnd_vn[n_bnd] = vn; bnd_sn[n_bnd] = sn; bnd_pc[n_bnd] = state.pc;
1970 memcpy(bnd_r[n_bnd], state.r, sizeof(bnd_r[0]));
1971 memcpy(bnd_f[n_bnd], state.f, sizeof(bnd_f[0]));
1972 cap_iprs(bnd_ipr[n_bnd]);
1973 n_bnd++;
1974 }
1975 if (vtr && seg + 1 < nseg && state.pc != vtr->segs[seg + 1].guest_pc) break; // path left the fused trace -> side-exit
1976 } // end per-segment interp loop
1977 if (clean)
1978 {
1979 // (cap_iprs/put_iprs are defined above the interp reference pass -- the per-boundary
1980 // side-exit snapshots need them there.)
1981 u64 ipr_interp[27];
1982 cap_iprs(ipr_interp);
1983 // FP file: compiled ITOFx writes state.f live (like the IPR writes); snapshot the
1984 // interp pass's result, compare after the compiled pass, then restore.
1985 u64 f_interp[64];
1986 memcpy(f_interp, state.f, sizeof(f_interp));
1987 u64 jr[64]; // 64: a compiled PALmode block may touch the shadow bank
1988 memcpy(jr, snap, sizeof(jr));
1989 memcpy(state.f, f_pre, sizeof(f_pre)); // restore the FP file like the GPRs: the compiled pass reads pre-interp f
1990 state.sde = ictl_sde_pre; state.hwe = ictl_hwe_pre; // restore I_CTL too: a compiled HW_MFPR must read the pre-interp value
1991 state.i_ctl_spe = ictl_spe_pre; state.i_ctl_va_mode = ictl_vam_pre;
1992 state.i_ctl_vptb = ictl_vptb_pre; state.i_ctl_other = ictl_other_pre;
1993 state.cm = cm_pre; state.sir = sir_pre; // ...and CM/SIRR
1994 flush_data_page_cache();
1995 state.aster = aster_pre; state.astrr = astrr_pre; // ...and the PCTX read-backs (a
1996 state.fpen = fpen_pre; state.ppcen = ppcen_pre; // HW_MFPR PCTX reads these live)
1997 const u64 interp_pc = state.pc; // interpreter is authoritative for the PC
1998 const u32 n_stores_interp = sn; // interp's RECORDED store count (sn), NOT the replay cursor m_jit_slog_i; a compiled pass must consume exactly this many (catches a missing/extra store)
1999 m_jit_vreplay = true;
2000 m_jit_vmismatch = false;
2001 m_jit_vlog_i = 0;
2002 m_jit_vlog_n = vn;
2003 m_jit_slog_i = 0;
2004 m_jit_slog_n = sn;
2005 dpc_sync_bank();
2006 m_jit->authorize_native(b, (uint32_t)state.cm); // replay uses the restored mode
2007 const u32 done = m_jit->run_block(this, jr, b); // also writes state.pc (the JIT's next PC)
2008 m_jit_vreplay = false;
2009 if (!vtr && done == b->prefix_len)
2010 {
2011 if (state.pc != interp_pc) {
2012 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2013 // Compare the observed source with the words classified for the
2014 // reference pass, including any family-provided cached overrides.
2015 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] PC MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%016llx jit=%016llx plen=%u\n",
2016 (unsigned long long) start_virt, (unsigned long long) interp_pc,
2017 (unsigned long long) state.pc, b->prefix_len);
2018 printf(" source:");
2019 for (u32 w = 0; w < b->prefix_len && w < 16; ++w) printf(" %08x", source_words[w]);
2020 printf("\n reference:");
2021 for (u32 w = 0; w < b->prefix_len && w < 16; ++w)
2022 printf(" %08x", verify_words[w]);
2023 printf("\n r1 i=%016llx j=%016llx r2 i=%016llx j=%016llx r5 snap=%016llx\n",
2024 (unsigned long long) state.r[1], (unsigned long long) jr[1],
2025 (unsigned long long) state.r[2], (unsigned long long) jr[2],
2026 (unsigned long long) snap[5]);
2027 }
2028 u64 ipr_jit[27];
2029 cap_iprs(ipr_jit); // compiled pass wrote IPRs into live state; check vs interp
2030 for (int ii = 0; ii < 27; ii++) if (ipr_ne(ii, ipr_jit[ii], ipr_interp[ii]))
2031 {
2032 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2033 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] IPR MISMATCH at %016llx slot %d: interp=%016llx jit=%016llx\n",
2034 (unsigned long long) start_virt, ii,
2035 (unsigned long long) ipr_interp[ii], (unsigned long long) ipr_jit[ii]);
2036 }
2037 for (int fi = 0; fi < 64; fi++) if (state.f[fi] != f_interp[fi])
2038 {
2039 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2040 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] FP MISMATCH at %016llx f%d: interp=%016llx jit=%016llx\n",
2041 (unsigned long long) start_virt, fi,
2042 (unsigned long long) f_interp[fi], (unsigned long long) state.f[fi]);
2043 }
2044 if (m_jit_vlog_i != vn) {
2045 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2046 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] LOAD COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u jit=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, vn, m_jit_vlog_i);
2047 }
2048 if (m_jit_slog_i != n_stores_interp) {
2049 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2050 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] STORE COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u jit=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, n_stores_interp, m_jit_slog_i);
2051 }
2052 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_compare(start_virt, state.r, jr, verify_words, b->prefix_len, m_jit_vmismatch) + g_diag_excluded_ns); // don't bill the verify progress-print OR the PCI decode-off diag stall to the RPCC
2053 g_diag_excluded_ns = 0; // consumed here in the verify path so jit_run's later sync doesn't double-count it
2054 }
2055 else if (m_jit_vmismatch)
2056 {
2057 // A deferred op (or a longer trace reference) prevents a GPR compare,
2058 // but any earlier replay mismatch still belongs to this compiled pass.
2059 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_failed());
2060 }
2061 // verify extension: the production trace-run hook is gated off under JIT_VERIFY, so
2062 // exercise the trace HERE; re-restore pre-interp state, run t->code on a 2nd scratch
2063 // (replaying the same logged loads), then compare to the authoritative interp. This makes
2064 // the trace's own state.pc write + frame visible to the differential harness.
2065 if (m_jit->traces_enabled()) {
2066 CJitEngine::TraceFragment* tr = m_jit->trace_lookup(start_virt, start_asn);
2067 if (tr && m_jit->trace_ok(tr, start_phys, sources)
2068 && [&]{ for (uint32_t s = 1; s < tr->n_segs; ++s) { u64 sp; if (!live_exec_phys(tr->segs[s].guest_pc, &sp) || sp != tr->segs[s].phys_pc) return false; } return true; }()) { // verify now mirrors the production hook's interior live-phys check
2069 memcpy(state.f, f_pre, sizeof(f_pre));
2070 state.sde = ictl_sde_pre; state.hwe = ictl_hwe_pre;
2071 state.i_ctl_spe = ictl_spe_pre; state.i_ctl_va_mode = ictl_vam_pre;
2072 state.i_ctl_vptb = ictl_vptb_pre; state.i_ctl_other = ictl_other_pre;
2073 state.cm = cm_pre; state.sir = sir_pre;
2074 flush_data_page_cache();
2075 state.aster = aster_pre; state.astrr = astrr_pre;
2076 state.fpen = fpen_pre; state.ppcen = ppcen_pre;
2077 state.exc_sum = exc_sum_pre; state.fpcr = fpcr_pre; // else the trace inherits the
2078 // interp's FINAL values -> false
2079 // mismatch at interior boundaries
2080 u64 jr_t[64];
2081 memcpy(jr_t, snap, sizeof(jr_t));
2082 m_jit_vreplay = true; m_jit_vmismatch = false; m_jit_vlog_i = 0; m_jit_slog_i = 0;
2083 m_jit_vlog_n = vn; m_jit_slog_n = sn;
2084 dpc_sync_bank();
2085 const u32 done_t = ((CJitEngine::JitFn)tr->code)(this, jr_t);
2086 m_jit_vreplay = false;
2087 if (done_t == n_interp) {
2088 if (state.pc != interp_pc)
2089 {
2090 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2091 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE PC MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%016llx trace=%016llx (n=%u)\n",
2092 (unsigned long long) start_virt, (unsigned long long) interp_pc,
2093 (unsigned long long) state.pc, n_interp);
2094 }
2095 u64 ipr_jit_t[27]; cap_iprs(ipr_jit_t); // trace wrote IPRs into live state; check vs interp (parity with the block path)
2096 for (int ii = 0; ii < 27; ii++) if (ipr_ne(ii, ipr_jit_t[ii], ipr_interp[ii])) {
2097 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2098 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE IPR MISMATCH at %016llx slot %d: interp=%016llx trace=%016llx\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, ii, (unsigned long long) ipr_interp[ii], (unsigned long long) ipr_jit_t[ii]);
2099 }
2100 for (int fi = 0; fi < 64; fi++) if (state.f[fi] != f_interp[fi]) {
2101 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2102 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE FP MISMATCH at %016llx f%d: interp=%016llx trace=%016llx\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, fi, (unsigned long long) f_interp[fi], (unsigned long long) state.f[fi]);
2103 }
2104 if (m_jit_vlog_i != vn) {
2105 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2106 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE LOAD COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u trace=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, vn, m_jit_vlog_i);
2107 }
2108 if (m_jit_slog_i != n_stores_interp) {
2109 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2110 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE STORE COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u trace=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, n_stores_interp, m_jit_slog_i);
2111 }
2112 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_compare(start_virt, state.r, jr_t, verify_words, n_interp, m_jit_vmismatch));
2113 m_jit->note_trace_verify(0); // full-span compare
2114 } else {
2115 // Early exit: legitimate if the trace stopped exactly at a fused-block
2116 // boundary the reference pass also crossed
2117 int bi = -1;
2118 for (u32 q = 0; q + 1 < n_bnd; ++q) if (bnd_cnt[q] == done_t) { bi = (int)q; break; }
2119 if (bi < 0) {
2120 // Mid-block early bail: a deferred op stops compiled execution AT that op
2121 // the BLOCK path silently skips its compare in exactly this case (done < prefix_len).
2122 // Identify it by the bail PC: the fault/bail path wrote state.pc = the op's own
2123 // address along the fused path.
2124 u64 bail_pc = 0; u32 cum = 0;
2125 for (u32 s2 = 0; s2 < tr->n_segs; ++s2) {
2126 if (done_t < cum + tr->segs[s2].n_instr) { bail_pc = tr->segs[s2].guest_pc + 4 * (u64)(done_t - cum); break; }
2127 cum += tr->segs[s2].n_instr;
2128 }
2129 if (bail_pc && state.pc == bail_pc) {
2130 if (m_jit_vmismatch)
2131 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_failed());
2132 m_jit->note_trace_verify(3); // deferred-op bail: compare skipped (block-path parity)
2133 } else {
2134 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2135 static int n_tcm = 0; // rate-limited: a real count divergence repeats -- 25 samples suffice
2136 if (n_tcm++ < 25)
2137 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp_span=%u trace_done=%u pc=%016llx\n",
2138 (unsigned long long) start_virt, n_interp, done_t, (unsigned long long) state.pc);
2139 m_jit->note_trace_verify(2); // true divergence: no boundary or bail-pc matches
2140 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_failed());
2141 }
2142 } else {
2143 if (state.pc != bnd_pc[bi])
2144 {
2145 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2146 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE SIDE-EXIT PC MISMATCH at %016llx: boundary=%016llx trace=%016llx (n=%u)\n",
2147 (unsigned long long) start_virt, (unsigned long long) bnd_pc[bi],
2148 (unsigned long long) state.pc, done_t);
2149 }
2150 u64 ipr_jit_t[27]; cap_iprs(ipr_jit_t);
2151 // Slots 0-2 (last TB fills) are replay-invisible (verify loads skip translation),
2152 // so they're only sound at full-span compares (by inheritance) -- skip here.
2153 for (int ii = 3; ii < 27; ii++)
2154 if (ipr_ne(ii, ipr_jit_t[ii], bnd_ipr[bi][ii])) {
2155 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2156 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE SIDE-EXIT IPR MISMATCH at %016llx slot %d: interp=%016llx trace=%016llx\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, ii, (unsigned long long) bnd_ipr[bi][ii], (unsigned long long) ipr_jit_t[ii]);
2157 }
2158 for (int fi = 0; fi < 64; fi++) if (state.f[fi] != bnd_f[bi][fi]) {
2159 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2160 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE SIDE-EXIT FP MISMATCH at %016llx f%d: interp=%016llx trace=%016llx\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, fi, (unsigned long long) bnd_f[bi][fi], (unsigned long long) state.f[fi]);
2161 }
2162 if (m_jit_vlog_i != bnd_vn[bi]) {
2163 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2164 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE SIDE-EXIT LOAD COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u trace=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, bnd_vn[bi], m_jit_vlog_i);
2165 }
2166 if (m_jit_slog_i != bnd_sn[bi]) {
2167 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2168 printf("[JIT][VERIFY] TRACE SIDE-EXIT STORE COUNT MISMATCH at %016llx: interp=%u trace=%u\n", (unsigned long long) start_virt, bnd_sn[bi], m_jit_slog_i);
2169 }
2170 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->verify_compare(start_virt, bnd_r[bi], jr_t, verify_words, done_t, m_jit_vmismatch));
2171 m_jit->note_trace_verify(1); // legitimate boundary side-exit
2172 }
2173 }
2174 }
2175 }
2176 state.pc = interp_pc; // restore; the block's PC write was only for the check
2177 put_iprs(ipr_interp); // roll back the compiled pass's live IPR writes (verify-only)
2178 memcpy(state.f, f_interp, sizeof(f_interp)); // ...and its FP writes
2179 break_seq_icache(); // compiled pass + raw pc restore bypassed set_pc
2180 }
2181 continue;
2182#else
2183 // A predecessor block's epilogue cache-missed and asked to be linked here. Now
2184 // that we know this block is live and compiled (and its vgen was just refreshed above),
2185 // snapshot it into the source's successor slots so its exit jumps straight in instead of
2186 // returning.
2187 //
2188 // Tag-keyed: an existing entry for this target MUST be refreshed in place.
2189 if (m_link_from) { m_jit->note_link_bail();
2190 m_jit->patch_edge(m_link_from, b->tag,
2191 b->vgen | (b->pal_shadow ? (U64(1) << 63) : 0), b->jit_body, b->asm_global,
2192 b->jit_body_same_page);
2193 m_link_from = nullptr; }
2194 m_jit_budget = budget; // ceiling for compiled chains (epilogue stops at it)
2195#ifdef JIT_STATS
2196 const uint64_t _comp_t0 = jit_rdtsc();
2197#endif
2198 dpc_sync_bank();
2199 const u32 done = m_jit->run_block(this, &state.r[0], b);
2200#ifdef JIT_STATS
2201 const uint64_t _comp_tsc = jit_rdtsc() - _comp_t0; // host cycles in this compiled chain
2202#endif
2203 state.r[31] = 0;
2204 break_seq_icache(); // compiled block wrote pc natively (no set_pc); drop the stale cursor
2205 // state.pc is written by the compiled block itself (next PC, or the bail PC).
2206 // Account for the compiled ops: instruction count (+ cc_large for the legacy speed
2207 // calibration). state.cc (RPCC) is no longer advanced per-instruction.
2208 // wall-clock * cpu_hz at the jit_run boundary above, so a hot compiled loop can't
2209 // run the cycle counter ahead of real time
2210 state.instruction_count += done;
2211 cc_large += (u64)done * cc_per_instruction;
2212 budget -= done;
2213#ifdef JIT_STATS
2214 {
2215 const uint64_t _ns = m_jit->note_exec(done, 0, _comp_tsc, 0);
2216 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(_ns); // don't bill the stats-print stall to the wall-clock RPCC
2217 if (_ns)
2218 {
2219 printf("[JIT][STATS][CPU%d] int-kicks: eir %llu | sir %llu | ast %llu | irq_h %llu | timer %llu | delivered %llu | masked-at-poll %llu\n",
2220 (int)state.iProcNum, (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[0], (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[1], (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[2],
2221 (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[3], (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[4], (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[5], (unsigned long long)m_stat_kick[6]);
2222 memset(m_stat_kick, 0, sizeof(m_stat_kick));
2223 printf("[JIT][STATS][CPU%d] tb: dtbm-single %llu | double %llu | itb-miss %llu | dfault %llu | tbia %llu | tbiap %llu | tbis_d %llu | fills %llu | hint-invalid %llu | hint-other %llu\n",
2224 (int)state.iProcNum, (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[0], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[1], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[2], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[3],
2225 (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[4], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[5], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[6], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[7],
2226 (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[8], (unsigned long long)m_stat_tb[9]);
2227 for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++)
2228 {
2229 int best = -1;
2230 for (int sl = 0; sl < 128; sl++) if (m_stat_va[sl][1] && (best < 0 || m_stat_va[sl][1] > m_stat_va[best][1])) best = sl;
2231 if (best < 0) break;
2232 printf("[JIT][STATS][CPU%d] miss-page %016llx x%llu\n", (int)state.iProcNum, (unsigned long long)(m_stat_va[best][0] << 13), (unsigned long long)m_stat_va[best][1]);
2233 m_stat_va[best][1] = 0;
2234 }
2235 memset(m_stat_va, 0, sizeof(m_stat_va)); memset(m_stat_tb, 0, sizeof(m_stat_tb));
2236 }
2237#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
2238 if (_ns && m_samples) jit_sampler_report();
2239#endif
2240 }
2241#endif
2242 if (done > 0) continue; // progress made; done==0 (faulting first insn) falls through
2243#endif
2244 }
2245
2246 // Miss path (cold): the up-front translation gave start_phys/start_asm (when have_phys).
2247 // We're not running a compiled block here, so drop any pending link request, interpret
2248 // the block, record it, and compile its prefix. Count the link-miss bail before dropping it.
2249 if (m_link_from) m_jit->note_link_bail();
2250 m_link_from = nullptr;
2251#ifdef JIT_STATS
2252 // Compiled with no code: the first op is a runtime breaker.
2253 if (have_phys && b && b->compiled && !b->code)
2254 {
2255 u32 breaker;
