2256 if (sources.read_word(start_virt, start_phys, start_asm, 0, breaker))
2257 m_jit->note_interp_breaker(breaker);
2258 }
2259#endif
2260 u32 n = 0;
2261 u64 expected = start_virt;
2262#ifdef JIT_STATS
2263 const uint64_t _interp_t0 = jit_rdtsc();
2264#endif
2265 while (budget > 0)
2266 {
2267 execute();
2268 --budget;
2269 ++n;
2270 expected += 4;
2271 if (state.pc != expected)
2272 break;
2273 }
2274#ifdef JIT_STATS
2275 cc_last_sync += std::chrono::nanoseconds(m_jit->note_exec(0, n, 0, jit_rdtsc() - _interp_t0)); // don't bill the stats-print stall to the wall-clock RPCC
2276#endif
2277 // Cached instructions may still differ from the legacy JIT's backing bytes.
2278 const bool src_stale = have_phys && !instruction_source_matches(start_virt, n);
2279
2280 // Record only translatable block starts (a translation miss left have_phys false).
2281 if (have_phys && !src_stale && state.pc != expected)
2282 {
2283 CJitEngine::JitBlock* nb = m_jit->record(start_virt, start_phys, start_asn,
2284 start_pal_shadow, start_asm, n, sources);
2285 if (!nb->compiled)
2286 m_jit->compile_block(nb, sources,
2287 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write,
2288 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_opcdec, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mfpr,
2289 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mtpr,
2290 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_write_phys, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_indirect,
2291 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_locked, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_stc,
2292 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_misc, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_vpte, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_read_wchk,
2293 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_itof, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_ftoi,
2294 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltl,
2295 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_read, (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_write,
2296 (void*)&CAlphaCPU::jit_fltv);
2297 }
2298 }
2299}
2300
2301// A diverging replay may issue more memory operations than the reference. Keep
2302// counting them, but never read stale or out-of-bounds log slots. The pass-level
2303// count comparison supplies the diagnostic and aggregates this failure once.
2304bool CAlphaCPU::jit_verify_load_slot(u32& slot)
2305{
2306 slot = m_jit_vlog_i++;
2307 if (slot < m_jit_vlog_n && slot < kJitVlogCap) return true;
2308 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2309 return false;
2310}
2311
2312bool CAlphaCPU::jit_verify_store_slot(u32& slot)
2313{
2314 slot = m_jit_slog_i++;
2315 if (slot < m_jit_slog_n && slot < kJitVlogCap) return true;
2316 m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2317 return false;
2318}
2319
2320// The emitted slow path installs the faulting current_pc; its exit commits earlier
2321// guest registers before PAL dispatch. Match DATA_PHYS before any memory side effect.
2322int CAlphaCPU::jit_unalign(u64 va, u32 ins, int flags, int align)
2323{
2324 if (!ins || m_jit_vreplay) return 1;
2325 state.fault_va = va;
2326 state.va_form_va = va;
2327 state.exc_sum = (u64)I_GETRA(ins) << 8;
2328 state.mm_stat = (I_GETOP(ins) << 4) | ((flags & ACCESS_WRITE) ? 1 : 0);
2329 TRACE_UNALIGN(flags, align);
2330 GO_PAL(AlphaPALException::Unaligned);
2331 return 2;
2332}
2333
2334// unaligned_fixup: perform a misaligned load/store in place. Every page the access touches is
2335// translated (and may fault) before any byte moves; MMIO bails to the interpreter.
2336int CAlphaCPU::jit_unaligned_rw(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, int size_bits, u32 ins, int rw, u64* data)
2337{
2338 if (!ins || cpu->m_jit_vreplay) return 1;
2339 const int n = size_bits / 8;
2340 const u64 va_last = va + n - 1;
2341 const int n1 = (int)(0x2000 - (va & U64(0x1FFF))); // bytes on the first page
2342 u64 phys[2];
2343 for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k)
2344 {
2345 const u64 a = k ? va_last : va;
2346 if (k && ((va ^ va_last) >> 13) == 0) { phys[1] = phys[0] + n - 1; break; }
2347 const u64 vp = a & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2348 SDataPageCache& dpc = cpu->dpc_slot(rw, a);
2349 if ((dpc.virt_page & ~(rw ? kDpcLLWatchTag : 0)) == vp
2350 && dpc.valid && dpc.cm == cpu->state.cm && dpc.asn == cpu->state.asn0)
2351 phys[k] = dpc.phys_base | (a & U64(0x1FFF));
2352 else
2353 {
2354 if (cpu->virt2phys(a, &phys[k], rw ? ACCESS_WRITE : ACCESS_READ, nullptr, ins)) return 2;
2355 dpc.phys_base = phys[k] & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2356 dpc.host_bias = ((phys[k] | U64(0x1FFF)) < cpu->dram_size)
2357 ? ((u64)cpu->dram_ptr + (phys[k] & ~U64(0x1FFF)) - vp) : 0;
2358 dpc.virt_page = dpc.host_bias
2359 ? (rw ? cpu->write_dpc_tag(vp, phys[k]) : vp) : ~U64(0);
2360 dpc.cm = (u8)cpu->state.cm;
2361 dpc.asn = (u8)cpu->state.asn0;
2362 dpc.valid = dpc.host_bias != 0;
2363 }
2364 }
2365 if (phys[0] >= cpu->dram_size || phys[1] >= cpu->dram_size) return 1; // MMIO: interpreter
2366 u8* p = (u8*)cpu->dram_ptr;
2367 u64 v = rw ? *data : 0;
2368 for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k)
2369 {
2370 const u64 pa = (k < n1) ? phys[0] + k : phys[1] - (n - 1 - k);
2371 if (rw) cpu->cSystem->cpu_write_ram(pa, 8, (u8)(v >> (k * 8)));
2372 else v |= (u64)p[pa] << (k * 8);
2373 }
2374 if (!rw) *data = v;
2375 return 0;
2376}
2377
2378// JIT load helper (static). descr[7:0] is size_bits; production loads also
2379// carry the instruction in descr[63:32]. That lets alignment/translation faults enter PAL
2380// exactly once instead of returning to execute() to repeat the faulting instruction.
2381int CAlphaCPU::jit_read(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u64 descr, u64* out)
2382{
2383 const int size_bits = (int)(descr & 0xff);
2384 const u32 ins = (u32)(descr >> 32);
2385 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2386 if (va & amask)
2387 return cpu->m_unaligned_fixup ? jit_unaligned_rw(cpu, va, size_bits, ins, 0, out)
2388 : cpu->jit_unalign(va, ins, ACCESS_READ, (int)amask);
2389
2390 u64 phys;
2391 const u64 vp = va & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2392 SDataPageCache& dpc = cpu->dpc_slot(0, va);
2393 if (dpc.virt_page == vp && dpc.valid && dpc.cm == cpu->state.cm && dpc.asn == cpu->state.asn0)
2394 {
2395 phys = dpc.phys_base | (va & U64(0x1FFF));
2396 }
2397 else
2398 {
2399#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
2400 cpu->m_dpc_miss[dpc.virt_page == ~U64(0) ? 0 : dpc.virt_page != vp ? 1 : 2]++;
2401#endif
2402 if (ins && !cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2403 {
2404 // The emitted cold stub installed state.current_pc before this call.
2405 // A nonzero result means virt2phys has already selected native-PAL fault.
2406 if (cpu->virt2phys(va, &phys, ACCESS_READ, nullptr, ins)) return 2;
2407 }
2408 else
2409 {
2410 // Verify/legacy callers do not carry an instruction word and retain the old
2411 // side-effect-free retry contract.
2412 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, ACCESS_READ);
2413 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, ACCESS_READ, access.asn);
2414 if (i < 0) return 1;
2415 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
2416 if (!e.access[0][access.mode] || e.fault[0]) return 1;
2417 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
2418 }
2419 dpc.phys_base = phys & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2420 dpc.host_bias = ((phys | U64(0x1FFF)) < cpu->dram_size)
2421 ? ((u64)cpu->dram_ptr + (phys & ~U64(0x1FFF)) - vp) : 0;
2422 dpc.virt_page = dpc.host_bias ? vp : ~U64(0);
2423 dpc.cm = (u8)cpu->state.cm;
2424 dpc.asn = (u8)cpu->state.asn0;
2425 dpc.valid = dpc.host_bias != 0;
2426 }
2427
2428 // DRAM only: bail on MMIO so the interpreter does device reads (side effects + ordering). This
2429 // MUST precede the verify replay: production bails here, and a device byte/word read is NOT
2430 // size-truncated (LDBU/LDWU use READ_VIRT, no sext func), so replaying an MMIO value and then
2431 // re-truncating it with movzx would falsely mismatch the interpreter. Bailing -> the compiled
2432 // block stops at the load (done < prefix_len) and the verify skips the compare, matching prod.
2433 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size)
2434 return 1;
2435
2436 // Verify replay: return the value the interpreter pass loaded here, rather than
2437 // re-reading (another CPU may have written it)
2438 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2439 {
2440 u32 i;
2441 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { *out = 0; return 0; }
2442 if (va != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2443 {
2444 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2445 static int n = 0;
2446 if (n++ < 50)
2447 printf("[JIT] LOAD ADDR MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx interp va=%016llx\n",
2448 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2449 }
2450 *out = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i];
2451 return 0;
2452 }
2453
2454 *out = dram_read(cpu->dram_ptr, phys, size_bits);
2455 return 0;
2456}
2457
2458// JIT FP load helper (static). descr packs size[7:0], format[17:16], instruction[63:32].
2459// FPSTART (fpen -> FEN bail; exc_sum=0) precedes the discarded-f31 and alignment checks.
2460// Production reuses jit_read's cache read/direct PAL faults; verify replays the interp's CONVERTED
2461// f-value (FP loads join the load log), so it consumes m_jit_vlog like an integer load.
2462int CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_read(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u32 fa, u64 descr)
2463{
2464 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap (FPSTART)
2465 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0;
2466 if (fa == 31) return 0; // f31 dest: interp skips the read
2467 const u64 amask = ((descr & 0xff) / 8) - 1;
2468 if ((va & amask) && !cpu->m_unaligned_fixup) // fixup: jit_read below splits the access
2469 return cpu->jit_unalign(va, (u32)(descr >> 32), ACCESS_READ, (int)amask);
2470 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2471 {
2472 u32 i;
2473 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { cpu->state.f[fa] = 0; return 0; }
2474 if (va != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2475 {
2476 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2477 static int n = 0;
2478 if (n++ < 50)
2479 printf("[JIT] FP LOAD ADDR MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx interp va=%016llx\n",
2480 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2481 }
2482 cpu->state.f[fa] = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i]; // logged converted value (no re-convert)
2483 return 0;
2484 }
2485 u64 raw;
2486 const int result = jit_read(cpu, va, descr, &raw);
2487 if (result) return result; // retain the distinction between retry and entered PAL
2488 switch ((descr >> 16) & 3) // fmt: 0=T raw, 1=S ieee, 2=F vax, 3=G vax
2489 {
2490 case 1: cpu->state.f[fa] = cpu->ieee_lds((u32)raw); break; // LDS
2491 case 2: cpu->state.f[fa] = cpu->vax_ldf((u32)raw); break; // LDF
2492 case 3: cpu->state.f[fa] = cpu->vax_ldg(raw); break; // LDG
2493 default: cpu->state.f[fa] = raw; break; // LDT raw
2494 }
2495 return 0;
2496}
2497
2498// JIT FP store helper (static). STS/STT: MEM[va] = convert(f[fa]) per DO_STS/DO_STT. Routes through
2499// jit_write so verify compares vs the store log (FP stores join it) and production writes.
2500int CAlphaCPU::jit_fp_write(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u32 fa, u64 descr)
2501{
2502 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap (FPSTART)
2503 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0;
2504 u64 value;
2505 switch ((descr >> 16) & 3) // fmt: 0=T raw, 1=S ieee, 2=F vax, 3=G vax
2506 {
2507 case 1: value = (u64)cpu->ieee_sts(cpu->state.f[fa]); break; // STS
2508 case 2: value = (u64)cpu->vax_stf(cpu->state.f[fa]); break; // STF
2509 case 3: value = cpu->vax_stg(cpu->state.f[fa]); break; // STG
2510 default: value = cpu->state.f[fa]; break; // STT raw
2511 }
2512 return jit_write(cpu, va, descr, value);
2513}
2514
2515// JIT MISC read helper (static). RPCC (sel 0): the wall-clock-pinned cycle counter (DO_RPCC, JIT
2516// lane), synced to now at each read. RC (sel 1) / RS (sel 2): read the interrupt flag, then clear /
2517// set it. All three read state the differential verify can't re-derive (cc is time-varying; the
2518// flag is consumed by the read), so in verify we replay the interp pass's value -- like a load.
2519u64 CAlphaCPU::jit_misc(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 sel)
2520{
2521 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2522 {
2523 u32 i;
2524 return cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i) ? cpu->m_jit_vlog[i] : 0; // no double side effect
2525 }
2526
2527 switch (sel)
2528 {
2529 case 0: // RPCC: Ra = cc_offset : cc[31:0]
2530 return cpu->rpcc_read(); // live read (NetBSD PCC timecounter) + collision progress
2531 case 1: // RC: Ra = bIntrFlag; bIntrFlag = false
2532 {
2533 u64 v = cpu->state.bIntrFlag ? 1 : 0;
2534 cpu->state.bIntrFlag = false;
2535 return v;
2536 }
2537 default: // RS (sel 2): Ra = bIntrFlag; bIntrFlag = true
2538 {
2539 u64 v = cpu->state.bIntrFlag ? 1 : 0;
2540 cpu->state.bIntrFlag = true;
2541 return v;
2542 }
2543 }
2544}
2545
2546// JIT int->FP move helper (static). ITOFx: f[fc] = fmt(value). Mirrors DO_ITOFx incl. FPSTART
2547// (fpen==0 -> return 1, the FEN-trap bail; exc_sum cleared). fmt: 0=T raw, 1=S, 2=F.
2548int CAlphaCPU::jit_itof(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 fc, u64 value, u32 fmt)
2549{
2550 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap: the interpreter vectors it
2551 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0; // FPSTART
2552 if (fmt == 1) cpu->state.f[fc] = cpu->ieee_lds((u32)value);
2553 else if (fmt == 2) cpu->state.f[fc] = cpu->vax_ldf(SWAP_VAXF((u32)value));
2554 else cpu->state.f[fc] = value;
2555 return 0;
2556}
2557
2558// JIT FP->int move helper (static). FTOIx: *out = fmt(f[fa]). Same FPSTART bail. fmt: 0=T, 1=S.
2559int CAlphaCPU::jit_ftoi(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 fa, u32 fmt, u64* out)
2560{
2561 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap: the interpreter vectors it
2562 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0; // FPSTART
2563 *out = (fmt == 1) ? sext_u64_32(cpu->ieee_sts(cpu->state.f[fa])) : cpu->state.f[fa];
2564 return 0;
2565}
2566
2567// JIT FLTL non-arithmetic helper (static). FPCR moves, sign-copies, FP conditional moves and the
2568// CVTLQ/CVTQL bit rearrangements -- mirrored verbatim from cpu_fp_operate.h; classify only routes
2569// these funcs here (no FP math, no /V trap forms). Returns 1 = FEN-trap bail.
2570int CAlphaCPU::jit_fltl(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 ins)
2571{
2572 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap: the interpreter vectors it
2573 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0; // FPSTART
2574 u64* f = cpu->state.f;
2575 const u32 fa = (ins >> 21) & 0x1f, fb = (ins >> 16) & 0x1f, fc = ins & 0x1f;
2576 switch ((ins >> 5) & 0x7ff)
2577 {
2578 case 0x010: // CVTLQ
2579 f[fc] = sext_u64_32(((f[fb] >> 32) & 0xC0000000) | ((f[fb] >> 29) & 0x3FFFFFFF));
2580 break;
2581 case 0x020: f[fc] = (f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) | (f[fb] & ~FPR_SIGN); break; // CPYS
2582 case 0x021: f[fc] = ((f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) ^ FPR_SIGN) | (f[fb] & ~FPR_SIGN); break; // CPYSN
2583 case 0x022: // CPYSE
2584 f[fc] = (f[fa] & (FPR_SIGN | FPR_EXP)) | (f[fb] & ~(FPR_SIGN | FPR_EXP));
2585 break;
2586 case 0x024: cpu->write_fpcr_arch(f[fa]); break; // MT_FPCR
2587 case 0x025: f[fa] = cpu->read_fpcr_arch(); break; // MF_FPCR (dest = Fa)
2588 case 0x02a: if ((f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) == 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVEQ
2589 case 0x02b: if ((f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) != 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVNE
2590 case 0x02c: if ((f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) && (f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) != 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVLT
2591 case 0x02d: if (!(f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) || (f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) == 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVGE
2592 case 0x02e: if ((f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) || (f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) == 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVLE
2593 case 0x02f: if (!(f[fa] & FPR_SIGN) && (f[fa] & ~FPR_SIGN) != 0) f[fc] = f[fb]; break; // FCMOVGT
2594 case 0x030: { // CVTQL (no /V form)
2595 u64 cvtql_src = f[fb];
2596 f[fc] = ((cvtql_src & U64(0xC0000000)) << 32) | ((cvtql_src & U64(0x3FFFFFFF)) << 29);
2597 if (FPR_GETSIGN(cvtql_src) ? (cvtql_src < U64(0xFFFFFFFF80000000)) :
2598 (cvtql_src > U64(0x000000007FFFFFFF)))
2599 cpu->write_fpcr_arch(cpu->state.fpcr | FPCR_IOV);
2600 break;
2601 }
2602 }
2603 return 0;
2604}
2605
2606// JIT VAX-FP arithmetic helper (static). FLTV (0x15): mirrors the interpreter's vax_* dispatch into
2607// f[fc]. FPSTART bail (return 1) if FP disabled. Returns 2 when the op delivered an arith trap: vax_trap
2608// GO_PALs (sets state.pc + exc_sum), so exc_sum != 0 detects it and the caller honors state.pc -- the op
2609// runs exactly once (no re-execute). Returns 0 on the common no-trap path. Fc==31 is gated out in classify.
2610int CAlphaCPU::jit_fltv(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 ins)
2611{
2612 if (cpu->state.fpen == 0) return 1; // FEN trap (FPSTART): op not run
2613 cpu->state.exc_sum = 0;
2614 u64* f = cpu->state.f;
2615 const u32 fa = (ins >> 21) & 0x1f, fb = (ins >> 16) & 0x1f, fc = ins & 0x1f;
2616 const u32 fn = (ins >> 5) & 0x7ff;
2617 UFP u;
2618 switch (fn)
2619 {
2620 case 0x0a5: case 0x4a5: f[fc] = (cpu->vax_fcmp(f[fa], f[fb], ins) == 0) ? U64(0x4000000000000000) : 0; break; // CMPGEQ
2621 case 0x0a6: case 0x4a6: f[fc] = (cpu->vax_fcmp(f[fa], f[fb], ins) < 0) ? U64(0x4000000000000000) : 0; break; // CMPGLT
2622 case 0x0a7: case 0x4a7: f[fc] = (cpu->vax_fcmp(f[fa], f[fb], ins) <= 0) ? U64(0x4000000000000000) : 0; break; // CMPGLE
2623 case 0x03c: case 0x0bc: f[fc] = cpu->vax_cvtif(f[fb], ins, DT_F); break; // CVTQF
2624 case 0x03e: case 0x0be: f[fc] = cpu->vax_cvtif(f[fb], ins, DT_G); break; // CVTQG
2625 default:
2626 switch (fn & 0x7f)
2627 {
2628 case 0x000: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fadd(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_F, false); break; // ADDF
2629 case 0x001: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fadd(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_F, true); break; // SUBF
2630 case 0x002: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fmul(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_F); break; // MULF
2631 case 0x003: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fdiv(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_F); break; // DIVF
2632 case 0x01e: cpu->vax_unpack_d(f[fb], &u, ins); f[fc] = cpu->vax_rpack(&u, ins, DT_G); break; // CVTDG
2633 case 0x020: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fadd(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_G, false); break; // ADDG
2634 case 0x021: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fadd(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_G, true); break; // SUBG
2635 case 0x022: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fmul(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_G); break; // MULG
2636 case 0x023: f[fc] = cpu->vax_fdiv(f[fa], f[fb], ins, DT_G); break; // DIVG
2637 case 0x02c: cpu->vax_unpack(f[fb], &u, ins); f[fc] = cpu->vax_rpack(&u, ins, DT_F); break; // CVTGF
2638 case 0x02d: cpu->vax_unpack(f[fb], &u, ins); f[fc] = cpu->vax_rpack_d(&u, ins); break; // CVTGD
2639 case 0x02f: f[fc] = cpu->vax_cvtfi(f[fb], ins); break; // CVTGQ
2640 }
2641 }
2642 return cpu->state.exc_sum ? 2 : 0; // exc_sum != 0 => vax_trap GO_PAL'd -> caller honors state.pc
2643}
2644
2645// JIT load-locked helper (static). LDx_L: the verify-checked load PLUS cpu_lock -- the LL/SC
2646// exclusive monitor. cpu_lock is per-CPU + atomic + idempotent.
2647int CAlphaCPU::jit_read_locked(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u64 descr, u64* out)
2648{
2649 const int size_bits = (int)(descr & 0xff);
2650 const u32 ins = (u32)(descr >> 32);
2651 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2652 if (va & amask) return cpu->jit_unalign(va, ins, ACCESS_READ, (int)amask);
2653
2654 u64 phys;
2655 const u64 vp = va & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2656 SDataPageCache& dpc = cpu->dpc_slot(0, va);
2657 if (dpc.virt_page == vp && dpc.valid && dpc.cm == cpu->state.cm && dpc.asn == cpu->state.asn0)
2658 {
2659 phys = dpc.phys_base | (va & U64(0x1FFF));
2660 }
2661 else
2662 {
2663#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
2664 cpu->m_dpc_miss[dpc.virt_page == ~U64(0) ? 0 : dpc.virt_page != vp ? 1 : 2]++;
2665#endif
2666 if (ins && !cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2667 {
2668 // The emitter installed current_pc. Translation faults enter native PAL here.
2669 if (cpu->virt2phys(va, &phys, ACCESS_READ, nullptr, ins)) return 2;
2670 }
2671 else
2672 {
2673 // Differential replay retains the side-effect-free lookup used by the
2674 // interpreter.
2675 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, ACCESS_READ);
2676 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, ACCESS_READ, access.asn);
2677 if (i < 0) return 1;
2678 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
2679 if (!e.access[0][access.mode] || e.fault[0]) return 1;
2680 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
2681 }
2682 dpc.phys_base = phys & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2683 dpc.host_bias = ((phys | U64(0x1FFF)) < cpu->dram_size)
2684 ? ((u64)cpu->dram_ptr + (phys & ~U64(0x1FFF)) - vp) : 0;
2685 dpc.virt_page = dpc.host_bias ? vp : ~U64(0);
2686 dpc.cm = (u8)cpu->state.cm;
2687 dpc.asn = (u8)cpu->state.asn0;
2688 dpc.valid = dpc.host_bias != 0;
2689 }
2690
2691 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size) // MMIO: interpreter handles the I/O-space locked path
2692 return 1;
2693
2694 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2695 {
2696 u32 i;
2697 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { *out = 0; return 0; }
2698 if (va != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2699 {
2700 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2701 static int n = 0;
2702 if (n++ < 50)
2703 printf("[JIT] LDx_L ADDR MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx interp va=%016llx\n",
2704 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2705 }
2706 *out = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i]; // the interp pass's (already sign-extended) value
2707 // The interpreter already established or consumed the real reservation.
2708 // Replaying a logged load must not publish a new one with a newer generation.
2709 return 0;
2710 }
2711 else
2712 {
2713 const u64 raw = cpu->cSystem->cpu_read_locked(cpu->state.iProcNum, phys, size_bits, cpu);
2714 *out = (size_bits == 32) ? sext_u64_32(raw) : raw; // LDL_L sign-extends; LDQ_L is the full quad
2715 }
2716 return 0;
2717}
2718
2719// Virtual HW_LD helper. "descr" carries the instruction plus transfer size/VPTE/ALT/WrChk flags.
2720// normal build will deliver translation faults directly; verify retains a side-effect-free replay probe.
2721int CAlphaCPU::jit_read_vpte(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u64 descr, u64* out)
2722{
2723 const int size_bits = (int)(descr & 0xff);
2724 const bool vpte = (descr & 0x100) != 0;
2725 const bool alt = (descr & 0x200) != 0;
2726 const bool wchk = (descr & 0x400) != 0;
2727 const u32 ins = (u32)(descr >> 32);
2728 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2729 // HW_LD translates the original VA, then its no-trap physical access rounds the
2730 // resulting physical address down.
2731
2732 u64 phys;
2733 const int flags = ACCESS_READ | (vpte ? VPTE : 0) | (alt ? ALT : 0) | (wchk ? WRCHK : 0);
2734 if (ins && !cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2735 {
2736 // The emitter installed current_pc. A nonzero result has already selected the
2737 // native-PAL DTB/access-fault entry.
2738 if (cpu->virt2phys(va, &phys, flags, nullptr, ins)) return 2;
2739 }
2740 else
2741 {
2742 // The reference interpreter already completed this instruction before verify replay.
2743 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, flags);
2744 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, flags, access.asn);
2745 if (i < 0) return 1;
2746 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
2747 const int cm = access.mode;
2748 if (!e.access[0][cm] || e.fault[0]) return 1;
2749 if (wchk && (!e.access[1][cm] || e.fault[1])) return 1;
2750 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
2751 }
2752
2753 phys &= ~amask;
2754
2755 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size) // MMIO: bail before the replay (mirrors jit_read)
2756 return 1;
2757
2758 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2759 {
2760 // Virtual HW_LD to R31 is a fault/access probe: Translation and MMIO checks
2761 // still matter, but its discarded value has no slot.
2762 if (((ins >> 21) & 0x1f) == 31)
2763 {
2764 *out = 0;
2765 return 0;
2766 }
2767 u32 i;
2768 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { *out = 0; return 0; }
2769 if (va != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2770 {
2771 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2772 static int n = 0;
2773 if (n++ < 50)
2774 printf("[JIT] HW_LD VIRT ADDR MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx interp va=%016llx\n",
2775 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2776 }
2777 *out = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i];
2778 return 0;
2779 }
2780
2781 *out = dram_read(cpu->dram_ptr, phys, size_bits);
2782 return 0;
2783}
2784
2785// JIT HW_LD WrChk helper (static). HW_LD func 0xa (DO_HW_LDL case 10, HRM TYPE 1012 WrChk): a
2786// longword VIRTUAL read that ALSO requires WRITE access -- the interpreter ACVs if read OR write
2787// protection is clear (virt2phys WRCHK) and faults FOR/FOW. Side-effect-free TB probe mirroring
2788// jit_read_vpte but checked vs CURRENT mode (not kernel); bails (interp re-runs + vectors the
2789// fault) on miss/protection/fault/MMIO. Verify replays the value like any load.
2790int CAlphaCPU::jit_read_wchk(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, int size_bits, u64* out)
2791{
2792 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2793 if (va & amask) return 1; // unaligned: let the interpreter handle it
2794
2795 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, ACCESS_READ | WRCHK);
2796 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, ACCESS_READ | WRCHK, access.asn);
2797 if (i < 0) return 1; // TB miss
2798 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
2799 const int cm = access.mode;
2800 if (!e.access[0][cm]) return 1; // no read access (ACV)
2801 if (!e.access[1][cm]) return 1; // no write access -- WrChk fails (ACV)
2802 if (e.fault[0] || e.fault[1]) return 1; // FOR/FOW: bail so the interpreter vectors the fault
2803 const u64 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
2804
2805 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size) // MMIO: bail before the replay (mirrors jit_read_vpte)
2806 return 1;
2807
2808 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2809 {
2810 u32 i;
2811 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { *out = 0; return 0; }
2812 if (va != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2813 {
2814 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2815 static int n = 0;
2816 if (n++ < 50)
2817 printf("[JIT] WCHK ADDR MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx interp va=%016llx\n",
2818 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2819 }
2820 *out = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i];
2821 return 0;
2822 }
2823
2824 *out = dram_read(cpu->dram_ptr, phys, size_bits);
2825 return 0;
2826}
2827
2828// JIT HW_LD helper (static). Physical read of size_bits at phys -> *out with NO translation -
2829// the PALmode HW_LD physical longword/quadword forms (func 0/1). Aligns like READ_PHYS_NT.
2830// Verify replays the interpreter's value (race-free); MMIO bails so the interpreter does the
2831// ordered device read. Returns 0 on success, 1 on a bail.
2832int CAlphaCPU::jit_read_phys(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 phys, int size_bits, u64* out)
2833{
2834 // MMIO: bail before the replay so verify models production (which bails here). A device read
2835 // isn't size-truncated, so a replayed+re-truncated value would falsely mismatch. dram_size is
2836 // page-aligned and the align below only rounds within 8 bytes, so this raw check is exact.
2837 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size)
2838 return 1;
2839
2840 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2841 {
2842 u32 i;
2843 if (!cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i)) { *out = 0; return 0; }
2844 if (phys != cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i])
2845 {
2846 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2847 static int n = 0;
2848 if (n++ < 50)
2849 printf("[JIT] HW_LD ADDR MISMATCH: compiled pa=%016llx interp pa=%016llx\n",
2850 (unsigned long long) phys, (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_vaddr[i]);
2851 }
2852 *out = cpu->m_jit_vlog[i];
2853 return 0;
2854 }
2855
2856 phys &= ~((u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1); // align like READ_PHYS_NT (ALIGN_PHYS)
2857 *out = dram_read(cpu->dram_ptr, phys, size_bits);
2858 return 0;
2859}
2860
2861// JIT store helper: the descriptor and three-way return contract match jit_read.
2862int CAlphaCPU::jit_write(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u64 descr, u64 value)
2863{
2864 const int size_bits = (int)(descr & 0xff);
2865 const u32 ins = (u32)(descr >> 32);
2866 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2867 if (va & amask)
2868 return cpu->m_unaligned_fixup ? jit_unaligned_rw(cpu, va, size_bits, ins, 1, &value)
2869 : cpu->jit_unalign(va, ins, ACCESS_WRITE, (int)amask);
2870
2871 // Verify: the interpreter pass already performed (and recorded) this store. Compare
2872 // rather than write -- stores change memory, not GPRs, so the differential GPR check
2873 // can't see them; this is how compiled stores get validated.
2874 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2875 {
2876 u32 i;
2877 if (!cpu->jit_verify_store_slot(i)) return 0;
2878 if (va != cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i] || value != cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i])
2879 {
2880 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2881 static int n = 0;
2882 if (n++ < 50)
2883 printf("[JIT] STORE MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx val=%016llx interp va=%016llx val=%016llx\n",
2884 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) value,
2885 (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i], (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i]);
2886 }
2887 return 0;
2888 }
2889
2890 u64 phys;
2891 const u64 vp = va & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2892 SDataPageCache& dpc = cpu->dpc_slot(1, va);
2893 if ((dpc.virt_page & ~kDpcLLWatchTag) == vp
2894 && dpc.valid && dpc.cm == cpu->state.cm && dpc.asn == cpu->state.asn0)
2895 {
2896 phys = dpc.phys_base | (va & U64(0x1FFF));
2897 }
2898 else
2899 {
2900#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
2901 cpu->m_dpc_miss[dpc.virt_page == ~U64(0) ? 0 : (dpc.virt_page & ~kDpcLLWatchTag) != vp ? 1 : 2]++;
2902#endif
2903 if (ins && !cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2904 {
2905 if (cpu->virt2phys(va, &phys, ACCESS_WRITE, nullptr, ins)) return 2;
2906 }
2907 else
2908 {
2909 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, ACCESS_WRITE);
2910 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, ACCESS_WRITE, access.asn);
2911 if (i < 0) return 1;
2912 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
2913 if (!e.access[1][access.mode] || e.fault[1]) return 1;
2914 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
2915 }
2916 dpc.phys_base = phys & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2917 dpc.host_bias = ((phys | U64(0x1FFF)) < cpu->dram_size)
2918 ? ((u64)cpu->dram_ptr + (phys & ~U64(0x1FFF)) - vp) : 0;
2919 dpc.virt_page = dpc.host_bias ? cpu->write_dpc_tag(vp, phys) : ~U64(0);
2920 dpc.cm = (u8)cpu->state.cm;
2921 dpc.asn = (u8)cpu->state.asn0;
2922 dpc.valid = dpc.host_bias != 0;
2923 }
2924
2925 if (phys < cpu->dram_size)
2926 cpu->cSystem->cpu_write_ram(phys, size_bits, value);
2927 else
2928 cpu->cSystem->WriteMem(phys, size_bits, value, cpu);
2929 return 0;
2930}
2931
2932// JIT HW_ST helper (static). Physical write of size_bits = value at phys with NO translation -
2933// the PALmode HW_ST physical longword/quadword forms (func 0/1). Aligns like WRITE_PHYS_NT.
2934// Verify compares against the interpreter's recorded store (stores change memory, not GPRs);
2935// MMIO bails so the interpreter does the ordered device write. Returns 0 on success, 1 on a bail.
2936int CAlphaCPU::jit_write_phys(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 phys, int size_bits, u64 value)
2937{
2938 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2939 {
2940 u32 i;
2941 if (!cpu->jit_verify_store_slot(i)) return 0;
2942 if (phys != cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i] || value != cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i])
2943 {
2944 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2945 static int n = 0;
2946 if (n++ < 50)
2947 printf("[JIT] HW_ST STORE MISMATCH: compiled pa=%016llx val=%016llx interp pa=%016llx val=%016llx\n",
2948 (unsigned long long) phys, (unsigned long long) value,
2949 (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i], (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i]);
2950 }
2951 return 0;
2952 }
2953
2954 phys &= ~((u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1); // align like WRITE_PHYS_NT (ALIGN_PHYS)
2955 if (phys >= cpu->dram_size)
2956 return 1; // MMIO: let the interpreter do the ordered write
2957 cpu->cSystem->cpu_write_ram(phys, size_bits, value);
2958 return 0;
2959}
2960
2961// JIT store-conditional helper (static). Same-address STx_C uses the emulator's
2962// CAS-backed MP model; different-address same-line STx_C stores without comparing
2963// against the LDx_L datum.
2964u64 CAlphaCPU::jit_stc(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 va, u64 descr, u64 value)
2965{
2966 const int size_bits = (int)(descr & 0xff);
2967 const u64 amask = (u64)(size_bits / 8) - 1;
2968 if (va & amask)
2969 return (u64)cpu->jit_unalign(va, (u32)(descr >> 32), ACCESS_WRITE, (int)amask) << 8;
2970 if (cpu->m_jit_vreplay)
2971 {
2972 u32 i;
2973 if (!cpu->jit_verify_store_slot(i)) return 0;
2974 const u64 success = cpu->m_jit_slog_success[i];
2975 if (va != cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i] || (success && value != cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i]))
2976 {
2977 cpu->m_jit_vmismatch = true;
2978 static int n = 0;
2979 if (n++ < 50)
2980 printf("[JIT] STx_C MISMATCH: compiled va=%016llx val=%016llx ok=%llu interp va=%016llx val=%016llx\n",
2981 (unsigned long long) va, (unsigned long long) value, (unsigned long long) success,
2982 (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_addr[i], (unsigned long long) cpu->m_jit_slog_val[i]);
2983 }
2984 return success;
2985 }
2986
2987 // Side-effect-free write-path translation (mirror jit_write); bail to the interpreter on a TB
2988 // miss / protection / fault-on-write so it does the side-effecting translation.
2989 u64 phys;
2990 const u64 vp = va & ~U64(0x1FFF);
2991 SDataPageCache& dpc = cpu->dpc_slot(1, va);
2992 if ((dpc.virt_page & ~kDpcLLWatchTag) == vp
2993 && dpc.valid && dpc.cm == cpu->state.cm && dpc.asn == cpu->state.asn0)
2994 {
2995 phys = dpc.phys_base | (va & U64(0x1FFF));
2996 }
2997 else
2998 {
2999#if defined(JIT_REGPROF) && defined(_WIN32)
3000 cpu->m_dpc_miss[dpc.virt_page == ~U64(0) ? 0 : (dpc.virt_page & ~kDpcLLWatchTag) != vp ? 1 : 2]++;
3001#endif
3002 const auto access = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.access(*cpu, ACCESS_WRITE);
3003 const auto address = cpu->m_profile.mmu_address.map(*cpu, va, ACCESS_WRITE, access.mode);
3004 if (address.kind == AlphaMMUAddressKind::Direct)
3005 phys = address.phys; // KSEG: never in the TB
3006 else
3007 {
3008 if (address.kind != AlphaMMUAddressKind::TranslationBuffer) return U64(0x100); // ACV
3009 const int i = cpu->FindTBEntry(va, ACCESS_WRITE, access.asn);
3010 if (i < 0) return U64(0x100); // TB miss
3011 const auto& e = cpu->state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i];
3012 if (!e.access[1][access.mode]) return U64(0x100); // protection (ACV)
3013 if (e.fault[1]) return U64(0x100); // fault-on-write (FOW)
3014 phys = e.phys | (va & e.keep_mask);
3015 }
3016 dpc.phys_base = phys & ~U64(0x1FFF);
3017 dpc.host_bias = ((phys | U64(0x1FFF)) < cpu->dram_size)
3018 ? ((u64)cpu->dram_ptr + (phys & ~U64(0x1FFF)) - vp) : 0;
3019 dpc.virt_page = dpc.host_bias ? cpu->write_dpc_tag(vp, phys) : ~U64(0);
3020 dpc.cm = (u8)cpu->state.cm;
3021 dpc.asn = (u8)cpu->state.asn0;
3022 dpc.valid = dpc.host_bias != 0;
3023 }
3024
3025 // Shared LL/SC path: consumes the monitor, applies the ABA sequence guard,
3026 // CASes RAM or performs the MMIO conditional store.
3027 return cpu->cSystem->cpu_stx_c(cpu->state.iProcNum, phys, size_bits, value,
3028 cpu->dram_ptr, cpu->dram_size, cpu);
3029}

3032 GO_PAL(AlphaPALException::OpcodeDecode) -- save the faulting PC in EXC_ADDR, vector to the PALcode OPCDEC entry,
3033 and clear the load-lock flag */
3034void CAlphaCPU::jit_opcdec(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 cpc)

3040u64 CAlphaCPU::jit_hw_mfpr(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u32 ins, u64 cur)
3041{

3044 {
3045 u32 i;
3046 return cpu->jit_verify_load_slot(i) ? cpu->m_jit_vlog[i] : 0;
3047 }

3049 return cpu->read_ipr(ins);

3057
3058// JIT indirect-jump chaining helper (static). For a compiled JMP/HW_RET, look up the block at the
3059// runtime target in this CPU's block cache (the dispatcher's own lookup -- validates valid + tag +
3060// asn/asm_global) and return its chained re-entry point if it's compiled and runnable in the current
3061// context; else null, so the compiled jump bails to the dispatcher. Keying on the actual target lets
3062// any number of distinct targets chain without the old single-slot link thrashing on varying jumps.
3063void* CAlphaCPU::jit_indirect(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 target, void* link_cache)
3064{
3065#if defined(JIT_STATS) && defined(JIT_STATS_RESOLVER_TSC) // two RDTSCs per call: perturbs throughput
3066 const uint64_t t0 = jit_rdtsc();
3067 void* const r = jit_indirect_impl(cpu, target, link_cache);
3068 cpu->m_jit->note_resolver_tsc(jit_rdtsc() - t0);
3069 return r;
3070#else
3071 return jit_indirect_impl(cpu, target, link_cache);
3072#endif
3073}
3074
3075void* CAlphaCPU::jit_indirect_impl(CAlphaCPU* cpu, u64 target, void* link_cache)
3076{
3077 cpu->m_jit->note_jmp_attempt();
3078 // Family entry preparation must not be bypassed by an indirect chain.
3079 if (!cpu->instruction_source_can_chain(target))
3080 return nullptr;
3081 CJitEngine::JitBlock* b = cpu->m_jit->lookup(target, (u32)cpu->state.asn,
3082 (target & 1) && cpu->state.sde);
3083 if (!b || !b->jit_body) return nullptr;
3084 auto hit = [&](void* body) -> void* {
3085 if (link_cache)
3086 cpu->m_jit->patch_edge(link_cache, target,
3087 cpu->m_jit->vgen() | (b->pal_shadow ? (U64(1) << 63) : 0), body, b->asm_global,
3088 b->jit_body_same_page);
3089 cpu->m_jit->jcache_fill(target, b->pal_shadow, body, (u32)cpu->state.asn);
3090 cpu->m_jit->note_jmp_hit();
3091 return body;
3092 };
3093 if (target & 1)
3094 {
3095 // PALmode target: the I-stream is physically addressed (not paged), so no remap / no stale
3096 // risk. lookup selected the body whose register-bank mapping matches the live SDE state.
3097 return hit(b->jit_body);
3098 }
3099 // Recheck the native mapping here; the dispatcher handles faults.
3100 const u64 gen = cpu->m_jit->vgen();
3101 const auto mapping = cpu->probe_instruction_source(target & ~U64(3));
3102 if (!mapping.valid) return nullptr; // let the dispatcher fault it in
3103 if (mapping.physical != b->phys)
3104 {
3105 // Caught a stale block: the page was remapped without flushing the JIT cache. Bail so the
3106 // dispatcher re-records/recompiles. Rate-limited log -- this firing confirms the stale chain.
3107 static int n = 0;
3108 if (n++ < 50)
3109 printf("[JIT][CPU%d] INDIRECT STALE: target=%016llx block_phys=%016llx -- recompiling\n",
3110 (int)cpu->state.iProcNum, (unsigned long long) target, (unsigned long long) b->phys);
3111 return nullptr;
3112 }
3113 b->vgen = gen; // re-validated -> fast path henceforth
3114 cpu->m_jit->authorize_native(b, (uint32_t)cpu->state.cm);
3115 return hit(b->jit_body);
3116}
3117#endif
3118
3124void CAlphaCPU::check_state()
3125{
3126 if (myThread && !myThread->isRunning())
3127 FAILURE(Thread, "CPU thread has died");
3128
3129#if !defined(CONSTANT_TIME_FACTOR)
3130 if (state.instruction_count > 0)
3131 {
3132 // correct CPU timing loop...
3133 u64 icount = state.instruction_count;
3134 u64 cc = cc_large;
3135 u64 time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start_time).count();
3136 s64 ce = cc_per_instruction;
3137
3138 u64 cc_aim = time * cpu_hz / 1000000; // microsecond resolution
3139 u64 ce_aim = cc_aim / icount;
3140
3141 s64 icount_lapse = icount - prev_icount;
3142 s64 cc_diff = cc_aim - cc;
3143 s64 ce_diff = (s64)((float)cc_diff / (float)icount_lapse);
3144
3145 s64 ce_new = ce_aim + ce_diff;
3146 if (ce_new < 1)
3147 ce_new = 1;
3148 if (ce_new > 200)
3149 ce_new = 200;
3150
3151 if (ce_new != ce)
3152 {
3153
3154 // printf(" time %12" PRId64 " | prev %12" PRId64 " \n",time,prev_time);
3155 // printf(" count lapse %12" PRId64 " | curr %12" PRId64 " | prev %12" PRId64 " \n",icount_lapse,icount,prev_icount);
3156 // printf("cc %12" PRId64 " | aim %12" PRId64 " | diff %12" PRId64 " | prev %12" PRId64 " \n",cc,cc_aim,cc_diff,prev_cc);
3157 // printf("ce %12" PRId64 " | aim %12" PRId64 " | diff %12" PRId64 " | new %12" PRId64 " \n",ce,ce_aim,ce_diff,ce_new);
3158 // printf("========================================================================== \n");
3159 cc_per_instruction = ce_new;
3160 // printf("cpu %d speed factor: %d\n",get_cpuid(),ce_new);
3161 }
3162
3163 prev_cc = cc;
3164 prev_icount = icount;
3165 prev_time = time;
3166 }
3167#endif
3168 return;
3169}
3170
3171void CAlphaCPU::count_down_irq_timers(int step)
3172{
3173 // The countdown and irq_h() must serialize the entire timer/line transition.
3174 // An atomic countdown alone could still assert EIR after a concurrent cancel.
3175 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> irq_lock(m_irq_lock);
3176 bool timers_pending = false;
3177 for (int line = 0; line < 6; ++line)
3178 {
3179 int& timer = state.irq_h_timer[line];
3180 if (!timer)
3181 continue;
3182 if (timer <= step)
3183 {
3184 timer = 0;
3185 state.eir |= (U64(0x1) << line);
3186#ifdef JIT_STATS
3187 m_stat_kick[4]++;
3188#endif
3189 state.check_int = true;
3190 }
3191 else
3192 {
3193 timer -= step;
3194 timers_pending = true;
3195 }
3196 }
3197 // Publish once, under the same lock used when a device arms or cancels a timer.
3198 state.check_timers = timers_pending;
3199}

3211void CAlphaCPU::promote_write_dpc_page(u64 phys)

3217 dpc.virt_page |= kDpcLLWatchTag;

3222
3232void CAlphaCPU::execute()
3233{
3234#ifdef ES40_JIT
3235 // Debugger/firmware stepping can also fill the write DPC, so it must take
3236 // part in the LL watch handshake even when called outside jit_run.
3237 CSystem::JitExecutionGuard execution(cSystem, state.iProcNum);
3238#endif
3239 u32 ins;
3240 int i = 0;
3241 u64 phys_address;
3242 u64 temp_64;
3243 u64 temp_64_1;
3244 u64 temp_64_2;
3245 UFP ufp1;
3246 UFP ufp2;
3247
3248 bool pbc = false;
3249
3250 int opcode;
3251 int function;
3252
3253#ifndef ES40_JIT
3254 // ---- Batch loop: execute up to 512 instructions before returning ----
3255 int _batch_budget = 512;
3256 u64 _cc_accum = 0; // accumulated cycle counts (flushed every 32 insns)
3257 int _icount_accum = 0; // accumulated instruction count
3258 const u64 _cc_per_ins = cc_per_instruction; // cache in register
3259#else
3260 const u64 _cc_per_ins = cc_per_instruction;
3261#endif
3262
3263#ifndef ES40_JIT
3264 {
3265 const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
3266
3267 // Wall-clock RPCC at batch granularity - same semantics as the JIT build. The
3268 // old per-instruction advance ran at cc_per_instruction rate, which lags real
3269 // time while the check_state feedback converges; SRM's cycles-per-tick speed
3270 // calibration measured that lag consistently and locked in a low CPU speed.
3271 sync_cc_wallclock();
3272
3273 service_interval_timer(now);
3274 }
3275
3276_next_instruction:
3277 if (--_batch_budget <= 0)
3278 {
3279 // Flush remaining accumulated counters before returning. state.cc is wall-clock
3280 // (advanced at batch top); _cc_accum only feeds cc_large for the legacy
3281 // check_state speed-factor feedback.
3282 state.instruction_count += _icount_accum;
3283 cc_large += _cc_accum;
3284 return;
3285 }
3286#endif
3287
3288#if defined(MIPS_ESTIMATE)
3289
3290 // Calculate simulated performance statistics
3291 if (++count >= MIPS_INTERVAL)
3292 {
3293 clock_t current = clock();
3294
3295 if (saved > 0)
3296 {
3297 double secs = (current - saved) / (double)CLOCKS_PER_SEC;
3298 double ips = MIPS_INTERVAL / secs;
3299 double mips = ips / 1000000.0;
3300 if (max_mips < mips)
3301 max_mips = mips;
3302 if (min_mips > mips)
3303 min_mips = mips;
3304 printf("ES40 MIPS (%3.1f sec):: current: %5.3f, min: %5.3f, max: %5.3f\n",
3305 secs, mips, min_mips, max_mips);
3306 }
3307
3308 saved = current;
3309 count = 0;
3310 }
3311#endif
3312#if defined(IDB)
3313 char* funcname = 0;
3314 dbg_string[0] = '\0';
3315#if !defined(LS_MASTER) && !defined(LS_SLAVE)
3316 dbg_strptr = dbg_string;
3317#endif
3318#endif
3319 state.current_pc = state.pc;
3320
3321 //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3322 // This section skips the memory check in SRM. Set the define in config_debug
3323 // for the memory check to run.
3324 //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3325#if defined(SKIP_SRM_MEMTEST) && !defined(ES40_JIT)
3326 // All five SRM mem-test patch points are in page 0x8b000 and only fire
3327 // during early SRM boot. Gate on the page so every other instruction pays
3328 // one compare instead of five.
3329 // JIT builds must NOT use these hooks - a block-cache miss interprets a few
3330 // iterations, thus only one hook like 0x8bb90 fires alone, and aborts the
3331 // fill while a still-compiled verify loop then runs, warm inits show mem errors
3332 // JIT is fast enough, even 16GB configs don't take long.
3333 if ((state.current_pc & ~U64(0xFFF)) == U64(0x8b000))
3334 {
3335 if (state.current_pc == U64(0x8bb90))
3336 {
3337 if (state.r[5] != U64(0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa))
3338 {
3339 printf("wrong memory check skip!\n");
3340 }
3341 else
3342 {
3343 state.r[0] = state.r[4];
3344 }
3345 }
3346
3347 if (state.current_pc == U64(0x8bbe0))
3348 {
3349 if (state.r[5] != U64(0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa))
3350 {
3351 printf("wrong memory check skip!\n");
3352 }
3353 else
3354 {
3355 state.r[16] = 0;
3356 }
3357 }
3358
3359 if (state.current_pc == U64(0x8bc28))
3360 {
3361 if (state.r[5] != U64(0xaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa))
3362 {
3363 printf("wrong memory check skip!\n");
3364 }
3365 else
3366 {
3367 state.r[8] = state.r[4];
3368 }
3369 }
3370
3371 if (state.current_pc == U64(0x8bc70))
3372 {
3373 if (state.r[7] != U64(0x5555555555555555))
3374 {
3375 printf("wrong memory check skip1!\n");
3376 }
3377 else
3378 {
3379 state.r[0] = 0;
3380 }
3381 }
3382
3383 if (state.current_pc == U64(0x8bcb0))
3384 {
3385 if (state.r[7] != U64(0x5555555555555555))
3386 {
3387 printf("wrong memory check skip2!\n");
3388 }
3389 else
3390 {
3391 state.r[3] = state.r[4];
3392 }
3393 }
3394 }
3395#endif
3396 //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3397 // end of skip memory test section
3398 //--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3399
3400 // Service interrupts
3401 if (DO_ACTION)
3402 {
3403#ifndef ES40_JIT
3404 // We're actually executing code. Cycle counter should be updated, interrupt and interrupt
3405 // timer status needs to be checked, and the next instruction should be fetched from the
3406 // instruction cache.
3407 // Increase the cycle counter if it is currently enabled.
3408 _icount_accum++;
3409 _cc_accum += _cc_per_ins;
3410
3411 if ((_batch_budget & 31) == 0)
3412 {
3413 // Flush accumulated counters to state. state.cc is wall-clock (batch top);
3414 // _cc_accum only feeds cc_large for the check_state speed-factor feedback.
3415 state.instruction_count += _icount_accum;
3416 _icount_accum = 0;
3417 cc_large += _cc_accum;
3418 _cc_accum = 0;
3419
3420 // There are one or more active delayed irq_h interrupts. Go through the 6
3421 // irq_h timers, decrease them as needed, and set the interrupt if the timer
3422 // reaches 0. Batch to reduce memory ops.
3423 if (state.check_timers)
3424 count_down_irq_timers(32);
3425 }
3426#else
3427 // New unwound interpreter / future JIT path
3428
3429 state.instruction_count++;
3430 cc_large += _cc_per_ins;
3431 // state.cc (RPCC) is pinned to wall-clock * cpu_hz at the jit_run boundary, not advanced
3432 // per-instruction here - interpreter can't run RPCC ahead of wall time.
3433
3434 // Process delayed irq_h timers one instruction at a time.
3435 if (state.check_timers)
3436 count_down_irq_timers(1);
3437#endif
3438
3439 if (state.check_int && !(state.pc & 1))
3440 {
3441 // Clear the interrupt doorbell up front. A remote irq_h() (e.g. an IPI from
3442 // another CPU) sets eir then re-raises check_int; clearing first guarantees a
3443 // cross-thread re-raise is re-checked next tick rather than lost by a late clear.
3444 state.check_int = false;
3445
3446 // One or more of the variables that affect interrupt status have changed, and we are not
3447 // currently inside PALmode. It is not certain that this means we hava an interrupt to
3448 // service, but we might have. This needs to be checked.
3449
3450
3451 if (state.pal_vms) {
3452 // PALcode base is set to 0x8000; meaning OpenVMS PALcode is currently active. In this
3453 // case, our VMS PALcode replacement routines are valid, and should be used as it is
3454 // faster than using the original PALcode.
3455
3456 // Native PAL handles chipset errors on irq<0> (Tsunami HRM 6.3.1)
3457 // and halt / MP work requests on irq<4>, before lower-priority interpreter work.
3458 if (state.eir & state.eien & 0x11)
3459 {
3460 GO_PAL(AlphaPALException::Interrupt);
3461 seq_remaining = 0;
3462#ifndef ES40_JIT
3463 goto _next_instruction;
3464#else
3465 return;
3466#endif
3467 }
3468
3469 // irq<1>=device, irq<2>=timer, irq<3>=IPI. (Was 0x6 = device+timer only,
3470 // which stranded incoming IPIs under VMS PALcode -> CPUSPINWAIT.)
3471 if (state.eir & state.eien & 0xe)
3472 if (vmspal_ent_ext_int(state.eir & state.eien & 0xe))
3473 return;
3474
3475 if (state.sir & state.sien & 0xfffc)
3476 if (vmspal_ent_sw_int(state.sir & state.sien))
3477 return;
3478
3479 if (state.asten && (state.aster & state.astrr & ((1 << (state.cm + 1)) - 1)))
3480 if (vmspal_ent_ast_int(state.aster & state.astrr & ((1 << (state.cm + 1)) - 1)))
3481 return;
3482
3483 if (state.sir & state.sien)
3484 if (vmspal_ent_sw_int(state.sir & state.sien))
3485 return;
3486 }
3487 else
3488
3489 {
3490
3491 // PALcode base is set to an unsupported value. We have no choice but to transfer control
3492 // to PALmode at the PALcode interrupt entry point.
3493 // if (state.eir & 8)
3494 // {
3495 // printf("%s: IP interrupt received%s...\n",devid_string, (state.eien&8)?"(enabled)":"(masked)");
3496 // }
3497 if ((state.eien & state.eir) || (state.sien & state.sir) || (state.asten
3498 && (state.aster & state.astrr & ((1 << (state.cm + 1)) - 1))))
3499 {
3500#ifdef JIT_STATS
3501 m_stat_kick[5]++;
3502#endif
3503 GO_PAL(AlphaPALException::Interrupt);
3504 seq_remaining = 0;
3505#ifndef ES40_JIT
3506 goto _next_instruction;
3507#else
3508 return;
3509#endif
3510 }
3511#ifdef JIT_STATS
3512 else m_stat_kick[6]++; // flag was set but nothing deliverable at the poll
3513#endif
3514 }
3515
3516 }
3517
3518 // If profiling is enabled, increase the profiling counter for the current block of addresses.
3519#if defined(PROFILE)
3520 PROFILE_DO(state.pc);
3521#endif
3522
3523 if (fetch_instruction(&ins))
3524 ES40_EXECUTE_END();
3525
3526 } // if (DO_ACTION)
3527 else
3528 {
3529
3530 // We're not really executing any code (DO_ACTION is false); that means that we're
3531 // in a debugging session, and just listing instructions at a particular address.
3532 // In this case, we treat the program counter as a physical address.
3533 ins = (u32)(cSystem->ReadMem(state.pc, 32, this));
3534#if defined(DEBUG_ARC)
3535 if (state.current_pc < 0x10000) {
3536 printf("PC=%016" PRIx64 " ins=%08x\n", state.current_pc, ins);
3537 }
3538#endif
3539 }
3540
3541 // Increase the program counter. The current value is retained in state.current_pc.
3542#if defined(IDB)
3543 next_pc();
3544#else
3545 state.pc += 4;
3546#endif
3547
3548 // Clear "always zero" registers. The last instruction might have written something to
3549 // one of these registers.
3550 state.r[31] = 0;
3551 state.f[31] = 0;
3552
3553 // Decode and dispatch opcode. This is kept very compact using the OP-macro defined in
3554 // cpu_debug.h. For the normal emulator, this simply calls the DO_<mnemonic> macro defined
3555 // in one of the other cpu_*.h files; but for the interactive debugger, it will also do
3556 // disassembly, where the second parameter to the macro (e.g. R12_R3) determines the
3557 // formatting applied to the operands. The macro ends with "return 0;".
3558#if defined(IDB)
3559 last_instruction = ins;
3560#endif
3561 opcode = ins >> 26;
3562
3563 // EV6 retires FP operates (ITFP/FLTV/FLTI/FLTL) into F31 at decode: no FEN
3564 // or arith trap (21264 HRM 2.5, Table 2-6). MT_FPCR (no dest) and MF_FPCR
3565 // (dest is Fa) are excluded.
3566 if (opcode >= 0x14 && opcode <= 0x17 && (ins & 0x1f) == 31
3567 && !(opcode == 0x17 && (((ins >> 5) & 0x7fe) == 0x024))
3568#if defined(IDB)
3569 && !bListing
3570#endif
3571 )
3572 ES40_EXECUTE_END();
3573
3574 switch (opcode)
3575 {
3576 case 0x00: // CALL_PAL
3577 function = ins & 0x1fffffff;
3578 OP(CALL_PAL, PAL);
3579
3580 // switch (function)
3581 // {
3582 // case 0x123401: OP_FNC(vmspal_int_read_ide, NOP);
3583 // default: OP(CALL_PAL,PAL);
3584 // }
3585 case 0x08:
3586 OP(LDA, MEM);
3587
3588 case 0x09:
3589 OP(LDAH, MEM);
3590
3591 case 0x0a:
3592 OP(LDBU, MEM);
3593
3594 case 0x0b:
3595 OP(LDQ_U, MEM);
3596
3597 case 0x0c:
3598 OP(LDWU, MEM);
3599
3600 case 0x0d:
3601 OP(STW, MEM);
3602
3603 case 0x0e:
3604 OP(STB, MEM);
3605
3606 case 0x0f:
3607 OP(STQ_U, MEM);
3608
3609 case 0x10: // INTA* instructions
3610 function = (ins >> 5) & 0x7f;
3611 switch (function)
3612 {
3613 case 0x40: OP(ADDL_V, R12_R3);
3614 case 0x00: OP(ADDL, R12_R3);
3615 case 0x02: OP(S4ADDL, R12_R3);
3616 case 0x49: OP(SUBL_V, R12_R3);
3617 case 0x09: OP(SUBL, R12_R3);
3618 case 0x0b: OP(S4SUBL, R12_R3);
3619 case 0x0f: OP(CMPBGE, R12_R3);
3620 case 0x12: OP(S8ADDL, R12_R3);
3621 case 0x1b: OP(S8SUBL, R12_R3);
3622 case 0x1d: OP(CMPULT, R12_R3);
3623 case 0x60: OP(ADDQ_V, R12_R3);
3624 case 0x20: OP(ADDQ, R12_R3);

4182void CAlphaCPU::listing(u64 from, u64 to, u64 mark)
4183{
4184 printf("%%CPU-I-LISTNG: Listing from %016" PRIx64 " to %016" PRIx64 "\n", from, to);
4185
4186 u64 iSavedPC;
4187 bool bSavedDebug;
4188 iSavedPC = state.pc;

4197 }
4198
4199 bListing = false;
4200 state.pc = iSavedPC;
4201 bDisassemble = bSavedDebug;
4202}

4209static u32 cpu_magic1 = 0x2126468C;
4210static u32 cpu_magic2 = 0xC8646212;
4211
4215int CAlphaCPU::SaveState(FILE* f)
4216{
4217 long ss = sizeof(state);
4218
4219 fwrite(&cpu_magic1, sizeof(u32), 1, f);
4220 fwrite(&ss, sizeof(long), 1, f);
4221 fwrite(&state, sizeof(state), 1, f);
4222 fwrite(&cpu_magic2, sizeof(u32), 1, f);
4223 printf("%s: %d bytes saved.\n", devid_string, (int)ss);
4224 return 0;
4225}
4226
4230int CAlphaCPU::RestoreState(FILE* f)
4231{
4232 long ss;
4233 u32 m1;
4234 u32 m2;
4235 size_t r;
4236
4237 r = fread(&m1, sizeof(u32), 1, f);
4238 if (r != 1)
4239 {
4240 printf("%s: unexpected end of file!\n", devid_string);
4241 return -1;
4242 }
4243
4244 if (m1 != cpu_magic1)
4245 {
4246 printf("%s: MAGIC 1 does not match!\n", devid_string);
4247 return -1;
4248 }
4249
4250 r = fread(&ss, sizeof(long), 1, f);
4251 if (r != 1)
4252 {
4253 printf("%s: unexpected end of file!\n", devid_string);
4254 return -1;
4255 }
4256
4257 if (ss != sizeof(state))
4258 {
4259 printf("%s: STRUCT SIZE does not match!\n", devid_string);
4260 return -1;
4261 }
4262
4263 r = fread(&state, sizeof(state), 1, f);
4264 if (r != 1)
4265 {
4266 printf("%s: unexpected end of file!\n", devid_string);
4267 return -1;
4268 }
4269
4270 r = fread(&m2, sizeof(u32), 1, f);
4271 if (r != 1)
4272 {
4273 printf("%s: unexpected end of file!\n", devid_string);
4274 return -1;
4275 }
4276
4277 if (m2 != cpu_magic2)
4278 {
4279 printf("%s: MAGIC 1 does not match!\n", devid_string);
4280 return -1;
4281 }
4282
4283 reset_idle_detector();
4284 printf("%s: %d bytes restored.\n", devid_string, (int)ss);
4285 last_dtb_virt[0] = last_dtb_virt[1] = 0;
4286 // RAM and TB state now belong to the restored state. Restored icache stays. Rest gets chucked.
4287 flush_data_page_cache();
4288 break_seq_icache();
4289 memset(icache_valid_modes, 0, sizeof(icache_valid_modes));
4290 state.rem_ins_in_page = 0;
4291#ifdef ES40_JIT
4292 m_link_from = nullptr; // pending link-patch request into pre-restore code
4293 if (m_jit) m_jit->flush(); // epoch bump: blocks/traces re-hash against restored RAM before running
4294#endif
4295 // The floor/debt state is intentionally not part of the legacy save-state
4296 // format. Rebase it to the restored architectural counter and a fresh host
4297 // epoch so a restore cannot create a false jump or bill paused wall time.
4298 cc_last_read = state.cc;
4299 cc_borrow = 0;
4300 cc_wall_remainder = 0;
4301 cc_last_sync = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
4302
4303 return 0;
4304}

4314
4325int CAlphaCPU::FindTBEntry(u64 virt, int flags)
4326{
4327 return FindTBEntry(virt, flags, m_profile.mmu_address.access(*this, flags).asn);
4328}
4329
4330int CAlphaCPU::FindTBEntry(u64 virt, int flags, int asn)
4331{
4332
4333 // Use ITB (tb[1]) if ACCESS_EXEC is set, otherwise the unified Dstream TB (tb[0]).
4334 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
4335 int rw = (flags & ACCESS_WRITE) ? 1 : 0;
4336
4337#define TB_ASN_MATCH(entry) ((entry).asm_bit || (entry).asn == asn)
4338
4339 // Page-indexed hint first, then the last match, then the linear scan (which refills the hint).
4340 const u32 h = tb_idx_slot(virt);
4341 int i = (int)m_tb_idx[t][h] - 1;
4342 if (i >= 0 && state.tb[t][i].valid
4343 && !((state.tb[t][i].virt ^ virt) & state.tb[t][i].match_mask)
4344 && TB_ASN_MATCH(state.tb[t][i])) return i;
4345
4346 i = state.last_found_tb[t][rw];
4347 if (state.tb[t][i].valid
4348 && !((state.tb[t][i].virt ^ virt) & state.tb[t][i].match_mask)
4349 && TB_ASN_MATCH(state.tb[t][i])) { m_tb_idx[t][h] = (u16)(i + 1); return i; }
4350
4351 for (i = 0; i < TB_ENTRIES; i++)
4352 {
4353 if (state.tb[t][i].valid
4354 && !((state.tb[t][i].virt ^ virt) & state.tb[t][i].match_mask)
4355 && TB_ASN_MATCH(state.tb[t][i]))
4356 {
4357 state.last_found_tb[t][rw] = i;
4358 m_tb_idx[t][h] = (u16)(i + 1);
4359 return i;
4360 }
4361 }
4362
4363#undef TB_ASN_MATCH
4364 return -1;
4365}
4366
4367int CAlphaCPU::initiate_acv_fault(u64 virt, int flags, u32 ins)
4368{
4369 int res;
4370
4371 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4372
4373 if (flags & ACCESS_EXEC)
4374 {
4375 state.exc_sum = 0;
4376 if (state.pal_vms)
4377 {
4378 res = vmspal_ent_iacv(flags);
4379 return res ? res : -1;
4380 }
4381
4382 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::InstructionAccessViolation) + 1);
4383 return -1;
4384 }
4385
4386 state.fault_va = virt;
4387 state.va_form_va = virt;
4388 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4389
4390 u32 opcode = I_GETOP(ins);
4391 state.mm_stat =
4392 (
4393 (opcode == 0x1b || opcode == 0x1f) ? opcode -
4394 0x18 : opcode
4395 ) <<
4396 4 |
4397 (flags & ACCESS_WRITE) |
4398 2;
4399 if (state.pal_vms)
4400 {
4401 res = vmspal_ent_dfault(flags);
4402 return res ? res : -1;
4403 }
4404
4405 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::DataFault) + 1);
4406 return -1;
4407}
4408
4453int CAlphaCPU::virt2phys(u64 virt, u64* phys, int flags, bool* asm_bit, u32 ins)
4454{
4455 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
4456 int i;
4457 int res;
4458
4459 bool forreal = !(flags & FAKE);
4460
4461#if defined IDB
4462 if (bListing)
4463 {
4464 *phys = virt;
4465 return 0;
4466 }
4467#endif
4468#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4469 if (forreal)
4470#if defined(IDB)
4471 if (bTB_Debug)
4472#endif
4473 printf("TB %" PRIx64 ",%x: ", virt, flags);
4474#endif
4475
4476 const auto access = m_profile.mmu_address.access(*this, flags);
4477 const int cm = access.mode;
4478 const auto address = m_profile.mmu_address.map(*this, virt, flags, cm);
4479 if (address.kind == AlphaMMUAddressKind::Invalid)
4480 {
4481#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4482 if (forreal)
4483#if defined(IDB)
4484 if (bTB_Debug)
4485#endif
4486 printf("acv-va-form\n");
4487#endif
4488 if (!forreal)
4489 return -1;
4490 return initiate_acv_fault(virt, flags, ins);
4491 }
4492
4493 if (address.kind == AlphaMMUAddressKind::AccessViolation)
4494 {
4495#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4496 if (forreal)
4497#if defined(IDB)
4498 if (bTB_Debug)
4499#endif
4500 printf("direct-acv\n");
4501#endif
4502 if (!forreal)
4503 return -1;
4504 return initiate_acv_fault(virt, flags, ins);
4505 }
4506 if (address.kind == AlphaMMUAddressKind::Direct)
4507 {
4508 *phys = address.phys;
4509 if (asm_bit)
4510 *asm_bit = true;
4511#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4512 if (forreal)
4513#if defined(IDB)
4514 if (bTB_Debug)
4515#endif
4516 printf("direct\n");
4517#endif
4518 return 0;
4519 }
4520
4521 // try to find it in the translation buffer
4522 i = FindTBEntry(virt, flags, access.asn);
4523
4524 if (i < 0) // not found, either trap to PALcode, or try to load the TB entry and try again.
4525 {
4526 if (!forreal) // debugger-lookup of the address
4527 return -1; // report failure, and don't look any further
4528 if (!state.pal_vms) // unknown PALcode
4529 {
4530
4531 // transfer execution to PALcode
4532 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4533 if (flags & VPTE)
4534 {
4535 // HRM 5.1.3: VA is NOT written for LD_VPTE misses
4536 state.va_form_va = virt;
4537 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4538 /*
4539 * I_CTL[VA_48] selects the DTB double-miss PAL entry.
4540 * state.i_ctl_va_mode packs bits [16:15] of I_CTL, so bit 0
4541 * here is the architectural VA_48 bit.
4542 */
4543#ifdef JIT_STATS
4544 m_stat_tb[1]++;
4545#endif
4546 const auto reason = (state.i_ctl_va_mode & 1)
4547 ? AlphaPALException::DataTlbDoubleMiss48 : AlphaPALException::DataTlbDoubleMiss43;
4548 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(reason) + 1);
4549 }
4550 else if (flags & ACCESS_EXEC)
4551 {
4552#ifdef JIT_STATS
4553 m_stat_tb[2]++;
4554#endif
4555 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::InstructionTlbMiss) + 1);
4556 }
4557 else
4558 {
4559 state.fault_va = virt;
4560 state.va_form_va = virt;
4561 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4562
4563 u32 opcode = I_GETOP(ins);
4564 state.mm_stat =
4565 (
4566 (opcode == 0x1b || opcode == 0x1f) ? opcode -
4567 0x18 : opcode
4568 ) <<
4569 4 |
4570 (flags & ACCESS_WRITE);
4571#ifdef JIT_STATS
4572 m_stat_tb[0]++;
4573 {
4574 const int h = (int)m_tb_idx[t][tb_idx_slot(virt)] - 1;
4575 if (h >= 0) m_stat_tb[state.tb[t][h].valid ? 9 : 8]++;
4576 const u64 pg = virt >> 13; const u32 sl = (u32)(pg * 0x9E3779B1u) >> 25;
4577 if (m_stat_va[sl][0] != pg) { m_stat_va[sl][0] = pg; m_stat_va[sl][1] = 0; }
4578 m_stat_va[sl][1]++;
4579 }
4580#endif
4581 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::DataTlbMiss) + 1);
4582 }
4583
4584 return -1;
4585 }
4586 else // VMS PALcode
4587 {
4588 if (flags & RECUR) // we already tried this
4589 {
4590 printf("Translationbuffer RECUR lookup failed!\n");
4591 return -1;
4592 }
4593
4594 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4595 if (flags & VPTE)
4596 {
4597
4598 // try to handle the double miss. If this needs to transfer control
4599 // to the OS, it will return non-zero value.
4600 if ((res = vmspal_ent_dtbm_double_3(flags)))
4601 return res;
4602
4603 // Double miss succesfully handled. Try to get the physical address again.
4604 return virt2phys(virt, phys, flags | RECUR, asm_bit, ins);
4605 }
4606 else if (flags & ACCESS_EXEC)
4607 {
4608
4609 // try to handle the ITB miss. If this needs to transfer control
4610 // to the OS, it will return non-zero value.
4611 if ((res = vmspal_ent_itbm(flags)))
4612 return res;
4613
4614 // ITB miss succesfully handled. Try to get the physical address again.
4615 return virt2phys(virt, phys, flags | RECUR, asm_bit, ins);
4616 }
4617 else
4618 {
4619 state.fault_va = virt;
4620 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4621
4622 u32 opcode = I_GETOP(ins);
4623 state.mm_stat =
4624 (
4625 (opcode == 0x1b || opcode == 0x1f) ? opcode -
4626 0x18 : opcode
4627 ) <<
4628 4 |
4629 (flags & ACCESS_WRITE);
4630
4631 // try to handle the single miss. If this needs to transfer control
4632 // to the OS, it will return non-zero value.
4633 if ((res = vmspal_ent_dtbm_single(flags)))
4634 return res;
4635
4636 // Single miss succesfully handled. Try to get the physical address again.
4637 return virt2phys(virt, phys, flags | RECUR, asm_bit, ins);
4638 }
4639 }
4640 }
4641
4642 // If we get here, the number of the matching TB entry is in i.
4643#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4644 else
4645 {
4646 if (forreal)
4647#if defined(IDB)
4648 if (bTB_Debug)
4649#endif
4650 printf("entry %d - ", i);
4651 }
4652#endif
4653 if (!(flags & NO_CHECK))
4654 {
4655
4656 // check if requested access is allowed.
4657 // WRCHK (HRM 6.4.1: HW_LD type 1012/1112 WrChk variants) requires that
4658 // BOTH read and write protection pass for the access mode -- fail if
4659 // the natural-direction access bit is clear OR (when WRCHK is set on a
4660 // read) the write access bit is also clear.
4661 if (!state.tb[t][i].access[flags & ACCESS_WRITE][cm]
4662 || ((flags & WRCHK) && !state.tb[t][i].access[1][cm]))
4663 {
4664#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4665 if (forreal)
4666#if defined(IDB)
4667 if (bTB_Debug)
4668#endif
4669 printf("acv\n");
4670#endif
4671 if (!forreal) // FAKE probe: report failure, don't vector the fault — caller re-runs it under the interpreter
4672 return -1;
4673 if (flags & ACCESS_EXEC)
4674 {
4675
4676 // handle I-stream access violation
4677 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4678 state.exc_sum = 0;
4679 if (state.pal_vms)
4680 {
4681 if ((res = vmspal_ent_iacv(flags)))
4682 return res;
4683 }
4684 else
4685 {
4686 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::InstructionAccessViolation) + 1);
4687 return -1;
4688 }
4689 }
4690 else
4691 {
4692
4693 // Handle D-stream access violation
4694 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4695 state.fault_va = virt;
4696 /* HRM 5.1.5/D.24: VA_FORM is derived from VA, which is written
4697 on every D-stream fault (incl. DFAULT), not just TB miss.
4698 Keep the VA_FORM snapshot current so the OS fault handler
4699 computes the right PTE. */
4700 state.va_form_va = virt;
4701 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4702
4703 u32 opcode = I_GETOP(ins);
4704 state.mm_stat =
4705 (
4706 (opcode == 0x1b || opcode == 0x1f) ? opcode -
4707 0x18 : opcode
4708 ) <<
4709 4 |
4710 (flags & ACCESS_WRITE) |
4711 2;
4712 if (state.pal_vms)
4713 {
4714 if ((res = vmspal_ent_dfault(flags)))
4715 return res;
4716 }
4717 else
4718 {
4719#ifdef JIT_STATS
4720 m_stat_tb[3]++;
4721#endif
4722 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::DataFault) + 1);
4723 return -1;
4724 }
4725 }
4726 }
4727
4728 // check if requested access doesn't fault.
4729 // WRCHK additionally requires that the FOW bit be clear -- HRM 6.4.1
4730 // WrChk variants check both FOR and FOW.
4731 if (state.tb[t][i].fault[flags & ACCESS_MODE]
4732 || ((flags & WRCHK) && state.tb[t][i].fault[1]))
4733 {
4734#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4735 if (forreal)
4736#if defined(IDB)
4737 if (bTB_Debug)
4738#endif
4739 printf("fault\n");
4740#endif
4741 if (!forreal) // FAKE probe: report failure, don't vector the fault — caller re-runs it under the interpreter
4742 return -1;
4743 if (flags & ACCESS_EXEC)
4744 {
4745
4746 // handle I-stream access fault
4747 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4748 state.exc_sum = 0;
4749 if (state.pal_vms)
4750 {
4751 if ((res = vmspal_ent_iacv(flags)))
4752 return res;
4753 }
4754 else
4755 {
4756 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::InstructionAccessViolation) + 1);
4757 return -1;
4758 }
4759 }
4760 else
4761 {
4762
4763 // handle D-stream access fault
4764 state.exc_addr = state.current_pc;
4765 state.fault_va = virt;
4766 /* HRM 5.1.5/D.24: VA_FORM is derived from VA, which is written
4767 on every D-stream fault (including FOR/FOW DFAULT), not just TB
4768 miss. Keep the VA_FORM snapshot current so the OS fault
4769 handler computes the right PTE address. */
4770 state.va_form_va = virt;
4771 state.exc_sum = ((u64)REG_1 & 0x1f) << 8; /* HRM 5.2.13: EXC_SUM REG[12:8] is 5 bits */
4772
4773 /* HRM 5.3.8 MM_STAT: FOR [bit 2] is set when a fault-on-read
4774 * error occurs during a read transaction with PTE[FOR] set.
4775 * FOW [bit 3] is set when a fault-on-write error occurs.
4776 * For HW_LD WrChk variants the chip is performing both a
4777 * read AND a write-protection check, so PTE[FOW] (if set)
4778 * is reportable too
4779 */
4780 u32 opcode = I_GETOP(ins);
4781 int for_bit =
4782 ((flags & ACCESS_WRITE) == 0)
4783 && state.tb[t][i].fault[0] ? 4 : 0;
4784 int fow_bit =
4785 (((flags & ACCESS_WRITE) || (flags & WRCHK))
4786 && state.tb[t][i].fault[1]) ? 8 : 0;
4787 state.mm_stat =
4788 (
4789 (opcode == 0x1b || opcode == 0x1f) ? opcode -
4790 0x18 : opcode
4791 ) <<
4792 4 |
4793 (flags & ACCESS_WRITE) |
4794 for_bit | fow_bit;
4795 if (state.pal_vms)
4796 {
4797 if ((res = vmspal_ent_dfault(flags)))
4798 return res;
4799 }
4800 else
4801 {
4802#ifdef JIT_STATS
4803 m_stat_tb[3]++;
4804#endif
4805 set_pc(state.pal_base + pal_exception_offset(AlphaPALException::DataFault) + 1);
4806 return -1;
4807 }
4808 }
4809 }
4810 }
4811
4812 // No access violations or faults
4813 // Return the converted address
4814 *phys = state.tb[t][i].phys | (virt & state.tb[t][i].keep_mask);
4815 if (asm_bit)
4816 *asm_bit = state.tb[t][i].asm_bit ? true : false;
4817
4818#if defined(DEBUG_TB)
4819 if (forreal)
4820#if defined(IDB)
4821 if (bTB_Debug)
4822#endif
4823 printf("phys: %" PRIx64 " - OK\n", *phys);
4824#endif
4825 return 0;
4826}
4827
4839void CAlphaCPU::add_tb(u64 virt, u64 pte_phys, u64 pte_flags, int flags, int asn)
4840{
4841 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
4842 int rw = (flags & ACCESS_WRITE) ? 1 : 0;
4843 const auto fill = m_profile.tb_fill.decode(*this, virt, pte_phys, pte_flags, flags);
4844 int i;
4845
4846 // Refill of a mapped page: the page-indexed hint finds it; otherwise take a fresh entry. A
4847 // stale duplicate left behind by a hint collision is harmless: lookups prefer the hint, and
4848 // every invalidate scans the whole buffer.
4849 i = -1;
4850 {
4851 const int h = (int)m_tb_idx[t][tb_idx_slot(fill.virt)] - 1;
4852 if (h >= 0 && state.tb[t][h].valid
4853 && !((state.tb[t][h].virt ^ fill.virt) & state.tb[t][h].match_mask)
4854 && (state.tb[t][h].asm_bit || state.tb[t][h].asn == asn))
4855 i = h;
4856 }
4857
4858 // Check the ITB if the hint missed; an existing mapping may have different
4859 // permissions even when the physical address is unchanged.
4860 if (t == TB_INDEX_ITB && i < 0)
4861 i = FindTBEntry(fill.virt, flags, asn);
4862 const bool itb_changed = (t == TB_INDEX_ITB) && (i >= 0)
4863 && (state.tb[t][i].phys != fill.phys
4864 || state.tb[t][i].match_mask != fill.match_mask
4865 || state.tb[t][i].keep_mask != fill.keep_mask
4866 || state.tb[t][i].asm_bit != fill.asm_bit
4867 || memcmp(state.tb[t][i].fault, fill.fault, sizeof(fill.fault)) != 0
4868 || memcmp(state.tb[t][i].access, fill.access, sizeof(fill.access)) != 0);
4869
4870 if (i < 0)
4871 {
4872 i = state.next_tb[t];
4873 state.next_tb[t]++;
4874 if (state.next_tb[t] == TB_ENTRIES)
4875 state.next_tb[t] = 0;
4876 }
4877
4878 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA)
4879 {
4880 // Invalidate both the entry being replaced and the mapping being installed.
4881 if (state.tb[t][i].valid)
4882 invalidate_data_page_cache(state.tb[t][i].virt, state.tb[t][i].match_mask);
4883 invalidate_data_page_cache(fill.virt, fill.match_mask);
4884 }
4885
4886 state.tb[t][i].match_mask = fill.match_mask;
4887 state.tb[t][i].keep_mask = fill.keep_mask;
4888 state.tb[t][i].virt = fill.virt & fill.match_mask;
4889 state.tb[t][i].phys = fill.phys;
4890 memcpy(state.tb[t][i].fault, fill.fault, sizeof(fill.fault));
4891 memcpy(state.tb[t][i].access, fill.access, sizeof(fill.access));
4892 state.tb[t][i].asm_bit = fill.asm_bit;
4893 state.tb[t][i].asn = asn;
4894 state.tb[t][i].valid = true;
4895#ifdef JIT_STATS
4896 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA) m_stat_tb[7]++;
4897#endif
4898 state.last_found_tb[t][rw] = i;
4899 m_tb_idx[t][tb_idx_slot(fill.virt)] = (u16)(i + 1);
4900
4901#ifdef ES40_JIT
4902 if (itb_changed && m_jit) m_jit->note_itb_invalidate(CJitEngine::kBumpRemap);
4903#endif
4904 if (itb_changed)
4905 {
4906 // Keep cached instruction bytes until IMB, but discard derived access proofs.
4907 // Recheck same-physical permission change on next fetch.
4908 memset(icache_valid_modes, 0, sizeof(icache_valid_modes));
4909 break_seq_icache();
4910 state.rem_ins_in_page = 0;
4911 }
4912
4913#if defined(DEBUG_TB_)
4914#if defined(IDB)
4915 if (bTB_Debug)
4916#endif
4917 {
4918 printf("Add TB---------------------------------------\n");
4919 printf("Map VIRT %016" PRIx64 "\n", state.tb[t][i].virt);
4920 printf("Matching %016" PRIx64 "\n", state.tb[t][i].match_mask);
4921 printf("And keeping %016" PRIx64 "\n", state.tb[t][i].keep_mask);
4922 printf("To PHYS %016" PRIx64 "\n", state.tb[t][i].phys);
4923 printf("Read : %c%c%c%c %c\n", state.tb[t][i].access[0][0] ? 'K' : '-',
4924 state.tb[t][i].access[0][1] ? 'E' : '-',
4925 state.tb[t][i].access[0][2] ? 'S' : '-',
4926 state.tb[t][i].access[0][3] ? 'U' : '-', state.tb[t][i].fault[0] ? 'F' : '-');
4927 printf("Write: %c%c%c%c %c\n", state.tb[t][i].access[1][0] ? 'K' : '-',
4928 state.tb[t][i].access[1][1] ? 'E' : '-',
4929 state.tb[t][i].access[1][2] ? 'S' : '-',
4930 state.tb[t][i].access[1][3] ? 'U' : '-', state.tb[t][i].fault[1] ? 'F' : '-');
4931 printf("Exec : %c%c%c%c %c\n", state.tb[t][i].access[1][0] ? 'K' : '-',
4932 state.tb[t][i].access[1][1] ? 'E' : '-',
4933 state.tb[t][i].access[1][2] ? 'S' : '-',
4934 state.tb[t][i].access[1][3] ? 'U' : '-', state.tb[t][i].fault[1] ? 'F' : '-');
4935 }
4936#endif
4937}
4938
4960void CAlphaCPU::add_tb_d(u64 virt, u64 pte, int dtb)
4961{
4962 add_tb(virt, pte >> (32 - 13), pte, ACCESS_READ, dtb ? state.asn1 : state.asn0);
4963}
4964
4985void CAlphaCPU::add_tb_i(u64 virt, u64 pte)
4986{
4987 add_tb(virt, pte, pte & 0xf70, ACCESS_EXEC, state.asn);
4988}
4989
4997void CAlphaCPU::tbia(int flags)
4998{
4999 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
5000 int i;
5001 for (i = 0; i < TB_ENTRIES; i++)
5002 state.tb[t][i].valid = false;
5003#ifdef JIT_STATS
5004 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA) m_stat_tb[4]++;
5005#endif
5006 state.last_found_tb[t][0] = 0;
5007 state.last_found_tb[t][1] = 0;
5008 state.next_tb[t] = 0;
5009 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA) flush_data_page_cache();
5010 else
5011 {
5012 memset(icache_valid_modes, 0, sizeof(icache_valid_modes));
5013 break_seq_icache();
5014 state.rem_ins_in_page = 0;
5015 }
5016#ifdef ES40_JIT
5017 if (t == TB_INDEX_ITB && m_jit) m_jit->note_itb_invalidate(CJitEngine::kBumpTbia);
5018#endif
5019}
5020
5029void CAlphaCPU::tbiap(int flags)
5030{
5031 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
5032 int i;
5033 for (i = 0; i < TB_ENTRIES; i++)
5034 if (!state.tb[t][i].asm_bit)
5035 state.tb[t][i].valid = false;
5036#ifdef JIT_STATS
5037 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA) m_stat_tb[5]++;
5038#endif
5039
5040 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA) flush_data_page_cache();
5041 else
5042 {
5043 memset(icache_valid_modes, 0, sizeof(icache_valid_modes));
5044 break_seq_icache();
5045 state.rem_ins_in_page = 0;
5046 }
5047#ifdef ES40_JIT
5048 if (t == TB_INDEX_ITB && m_jit) m_jit->note_itb_invalidate(CJitEngine::kBumpTbiap);
5049#endif
5050}
5051
5058void CAlphaCPU::tbis(u64 virt, int flags)
5059{
5060 int t = (flags & ACCESS_EXEC) ? TB_INDEX_ITB : TB_INDEX_DATA;
5061
5062 if (t == TB_INDEX_DATA)
5063 {
5064 tbis_d(virt, state.asn0);
5065 if (state.asn1 != state.asn0)
5066 tbis_d(virt, state.asn1);
5067 return;
5068 }
5069
5070 int i = FindTBEntry(virt, flags);
5071 if (i >= 0)
5072 state.tb[t][i].valid = false;
5073 memset(icache_valid_modes, 0, sizeof(icache_valid_modes));
5074 break_seq_icache();
5075 state.rem_ins_in_page = 0;
5076#ifdef ES40_JIT
5077 // Native permission proofs can outlive the ITB entry that supplied them.
5078 // Its original granularity hint may cover other 8 KiB pages even if today's matching entry is absent or smaller.
5079 // Retire all incoming links until those original translation extents are tracked with the retained proofs.
5080 if (m_jit) m_jit->note_itb_invalidate(CJitEngine::kBumpTbis);
5081#endif
5082}
5083
5084void CAlphaCPU::tbis_d(u64 virt, int asn)
5085{
5086 bool found = false;
5087#ifdef JIT_STATS
5088 m_stat_tb[6]++;
5089#endif
5090
5091 for (int i = 0; i < TB_ENTRIES; i++)
5092 {
5093 if (state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].valid
5094 && !((state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].virt ^ virt) & state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].match_mask)
5095 && (state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].asm_bit || state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].asn == asn))
5096 {
5097 invalidate_data_page_cache(state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].virt,
5098 state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].match_mask);
5099 state.tb[TB_INDEX_DATA][i].valid = false;
5100 found = true;
5101 }
5102 }
5103
5104 // If the TB entry was already evicted, an old base-page DPC line can still exist.
5105 // Retire its direct slot using the mask recognized by the cache's fast path.
5106 if (!found)
5107 invalidate_data_page_cache(virt, U64(0x0000ffffffffe000));
5108}
5109
